1.name: CART SURFER
1.label: CART SURFER
1.flavor_text: "Dude, I'm totally gonna get like 500 coins this time," says a penguin ripping down the track. "I run through the cave and get sweet air with my 360s and backflips."

2.name: COFFEE SHOP
2.label: COFFEE SHOP
2.flavor_text: "Many of our customers come here for some quiet while they read the latest newspaper," explains a staff member. "Ballistic biscotti is our most popular menu item."

3.name: ASTRO-BARRIER
3.label: ASTRO-BARRIER
3.flavor_text: "I remember when Astro-Barrier came out. It was the first arcade game on the island!" recalls an avid gamer in the Lounge. "Have you found the secret levels yet?"

4.name: HOT CHOCOLATE
4.label: HOT CHOCOLATE
4.flavor_text: "The trick to a great cup of coffee is the time it takes to pour," explains the Coffee Stop staff. "Not too fast but not too slow, then save some room for marshmallows!"

5.name: LANDING PAD
5.label: LANDING PAD
5.flavor_text: "The landing pads around the island are built out of special alloys that disable them from being adversely affected by jet pack heat," explains Gary. "That means they're strong."

6.name: PIZZA CHEF
6.label: PIZZA CHEF
6.flavor_text: "First you start with the pizza dough, which gets flattened into pans," the chef continues. "Then it goes down the Pizzatron 3000 line and roasts in the oven."

7.name: PAINT BY LETTERS
7.label: PAINT BY LETTERS
7.flavor_text: "This one's my favorite story in the Book Room because it's about my favorite day of the year," he says. "Besides, I love any story that involves aliens and flashlights."

8.name: MINE
8.label: MINE
8.flavor_text: "The Mine is so cool. I can see all kinds of stalactites on the ceiling," explains the scientist. "Stalactites are those things that look like icicles. Oh wait... they're just icicles."

9.name: CONSTRUCTION WORKER
9.label: CONSTRUCTION WORKER
9.flavor_text: "It's amazing what you can do with a plain old drill," notes a worker on a job site near the coast. "I've seen some nice red ones, but I like my trusty yellow drill. It does just the trick."

10.name: JET PACK ADVENTURE
10.label: JET PACK ADVENTURE
10.flavor_text: "I love going on adventures with my jet pack. I can almost navigate through the entire course without getting a single coin," boasts the proud pilot. "It's not too easy, though..."

11.name: GIFT SHOP
11.label: GIFT SHOP
11.flavor_text: "I come in at least twice a week, I'd say," concludes the shopping penguin, decked out in the latest styles. "The diva glasses and The Sidetied wig are must haves."

12.name: HIKING IN THE FOREST
12.label: HIKING IN THE FOREST
12.flavor_text: "It's the perfect day for a hike in the Forest," says the penguin, holding her backpack on her shoulders. "Keeping active is really important, plus I love the great outdoors!"

13.name: RESCUE SQUAD
13.label: RESCUE SQUAD
13.flavor_text: "When you've got a penguin who's stuck in the snow / Just tell 'em exactly where to go / To the Rescue Squad on top of the hill / We know how to help and ya know we will!"

14.name: PET SHOP
14.label: PET SHOP
14.flavor_text: "This here is the puffle area, You'll be responsible for caring for these little critters," explains the Pet Shop owner. "The black one over there is a bit of a firecracker."

15.name: SKI VILLAGE
15.label: SKI VILLAGE
15.flavor_text: "I usually start a tour here at the Ski Village because it's so close to my tour booth," explains a tour guide. It's a great place to build a group of tourists, too."

16.name: ICE HOCKEY
16.label: ICE HOCKEY
16.flavor_text: It's the day of the big game at the Sports Party as Team Red and Blue square off head-to-head. "This time the trophy belongs to Red!" shouts the challenger as the puck drops.

17.name: SKI HILL
17.label: SKI HILL
17.flavor_text: "This must be the place she was talking about with all the sledding penguins," says the red penguin. "Now what on earth is that pointy thing up there for?"

18.name: SNOWBALL FIGHT
18.label: SNOWBALL FIGHT
18.flavor_text: "Here comes a long one!" one penguin shouts. "Yikes! That was close!" shrieks the other penguin. "Guess I'm better with water balloons..."

19.name: SNOW FORTS
19.label: SNOW FORTS
19.flavor_text: "I'm practicing my snowball pitch. I pretend this is the pitcher's mound, then wind up and let it fly. The Snow Forts are the perfect place to test out your pitching arm."

20.name: SOCCER
20.label: SOCCER
20.flavor_text: "Okay, look. Let's get this straight. I know some penguins out west call it a soccer ball, but it's football. Now that you understand the game, ready to try and score a goal?"

21.name: BEACH
21.label: BEACH
21.flavor_text: "I remember when the Beach opened as though it was yesterday," replies one island veteran. "We threw a big barbecue with the fish we caught. Ahhh... those were golden days..."

22.name: FOOTBALL
22.label: FOOTBALL
22.flavor_text: "10... 24... 5... hut!" shouts the quarterback as he makes a run for it across the field, racing for the 10-yard line. "Team Red's not gonna win it this time," he thinks as he's running...

23.name: BASEBALL
23.label: BASEBALL
23.flavor_text: "BATTER UP!" shouts the umpire as Team Red's pitcher readies the first throw of the big ball game. "This one's for the Blue Team!" shouts the batter as the ball flies towards the plate...

24.name: EMERALD PRINCESS
24.label: EMERALD PRINCESS
24.flavor_text: "Welcome to my beautiful enchanted castle!" beams the sparkly princess penguin. "I'm looking for my wand, which I seem to have misplaced. Could you help me look for it?"

25.name: BEAN COUNTERS
25.label: BEAN COUNTERS
25.flavor_text: "Why do they insist on delivering more fish?!" exclaims the employee catching the order from the delivery truck. "Is it just me or are there more fish than java bags here?"

26.name: MANHOLE COVER
26.label: MANHOLE COVER
26.flavor_text: "When you lift this manhole cover up, you'll see that it leads down to the pool," explains the Tour Guide. "And since we're not using out maps right now, shall we continue?"

27.name: NEWSPAPER ARCHIVES
27.label: NEWSPAPER ARCHIVES
27.flavor_text: "Sometimes I don't get a chance to read the newspaper, so I catch up with the past issues in the Boiler Room," says the lime green penguin. "I don't want to miss any comics!"

28.name: UNDERGROUND POOL
28.label: UNDERGROUND POOL
28.flavor_text: "Hey, do you remember when there wasn't a pool in here?" asks one of the penguins. "I remember a party where we were dancing on the ground in this very spot!"

29.name: SCUBA DIVING
29.label: SCUBA DIVING
29.flavor_text: "While Rockhopper travels at seas to find treasures, I prefer to search at home," the diver explains. "See! Check it out! A coral crown thing! Diving totally rules."

30.name: ICE FISHING
30.label: ICE FISHING
30.flavor_text: "I think the last time I was here, I caught about 10 fish," he replies. "I'm not in a rush when I go fishing. To me, it's about fun, not finance. If I need coins, I help at the Pet Shop."

31.name: CASE OF THE MISSING COINS
31.label: CASE OF THE MISSING COINS
31.flavor_text: "You totally saved my feathers there," sighs the relieved rookie agent. "I thought I was never going to get back into the vault after I closed the door! Oops, I guess!"

32.name: CRATES AND BOXES
32.label: CRATES AND BOXES
32.flavor_text: "EVERYONE MAKE WAY FOR BOXMAN!" shouts the penguin in the superhero mask. "I shall put all evildoers into my superboxes for shipment to 'No More Bad Guys Land'!"

33.name: ANVIL SMITH
33.label: ANVIL SMITH
33.flavor_text: The residents of Club Penguin appreciate a good anvil – that's why so many are sent to the Coffee Shop every day. "I'd say I make about 30 on a good day," replies one anvil smith.

34.name: HALLOWEEN
34.label: HALLOWEEN
34.flavor_text: "Check it out! I'm a ghost bunny professor!" explains the orange penguin. "I want to have the coolest costume for this solar eclipse party at my buddy's igloo. Do you think I'll win?"

35.name: KNIGHT
35.label: KNIGHT
35.flavor_text: "Let's pretend to be knights and princesses. I'll be the Knight of Light and you can be the Princess of Power," says the green penguin. "Oh no! Here comes a dragon..."

36.name: BLACK PUFFLE
36.label: BLACK PUFFLE
36.flavor_text: "Turbo is my black puffle. It rolls its eyes a lot," replies the penguin as he feeds his pet a flipper full of Puffle O's. "It really gets fired up when I take it out for a walk."

37.name: MEDIEVAL PARTY
37.label: MEDIEVAL PARTY
37.flavor_text: "For this event we collaborated with Penguin Style's fashion designers to make an epic party," says one planner, dressed in a knight's garb. "I still wear my party clothes today."

38.name: BLUE PUFFLE
38.label: BLUE PUFFLE
38.flavor_text: "As an employee, I value the blue puffles," replies the staff member. "They are loyal, easy to take care of, and fun to play ball with. You can't go wrong with a blue puffle."

39.name: PINK PUFFLE
39.label: PINK PUFFLE
39.flavor_text: "This is my pink puffle, Cutie! I named it that because I think its eyes are sooo adorable," continues the ballet dancer. "Plus it matches my outfit!"

40.name: GREEN PUFFLE
40.label: GREEN PUFFLE
40.flavor_text: "My puffle Greenie is the silliest puffle I've ever met, which is why we get along so well," she giggles. "I love it when it plays on its unicycle – it's so funny!"

41.name: PUFFLE FURNITURE
41.label: PUFFLE FURNITURE
41.flavor_text: "No igloo would be complete without accessories for your cute little puffle pets," the decorator explains. "Puffles love having furniture just as much as penguins!"

42.name: PURPLE PUFFLE
42.label: PURPLE PUFFLE
42.flavor_text: "Oh! Look at that one over there blowing bubbles! That one is sooo cute – it should be my pet," she exclaims. "I'll name it Princess Purple because I love princesses and purple!"

43.name: RED PUFFLE
43.label: RED PUFFLE
43.flavor_text: "This is my sidekick on my adventures. I named it Fireball because it's so fast when it goes flying out of its cannon like whoooosh! Look, it's going again!"

44.name: YELLOW PUFFLE
44.label: YELLOW PUFFLE
44.flavor_text: "I knew I wanted a yellow puffle from the moment I saw it in the Forest at Halloween," she replies. "My puffle Lemon likes to paint just like I do."

45.name: SUMMER PARTY
45.label: SUMMER PARTY
45.flavor_text: "The Summer Party sticks out the most in my mind as the one to beat," proclaims one penguin. "You can't top great buddies acting crazy and having fun."

46.name: GRAY FISH
46.label: GRAY FISH
46.flavor_text: "You ain't gonna get a bite without the Flashing Lure, sonny," the experienced brown fisherman explains. "Them gray ones are only attracted to real bright light."

47.name: O BERRY
47.label: O BERRY
47.flavor_text: "These berries grow on shrubs in the forest clearing," explains our nature guide. "Puffles love to eat them because of their tart sweetness."

48.name: LIFE RING
48.label: LIFE RING
48.flavor_text: "Having a life ring handy is really important to us," the lifeguard continues as she keeps watch over the Pool. "Hey, that crab is knocking on the glass over there!"

49.name: JOLLY ROGER FLAG
49.label: JOLLY ROGER FLAG
49.flavor_text: "Arrr, this be the black flag atop me ship," growls Rockhopper as we tour the Migrator. "I be liking to name things, so I be callin' this one the Jolly Roger."

50.name: COINS
50.label: COINS
50.flavor_text: "Coins are the widely accepted monetary system around the island," explains the scholarly account penguin. "That means penguins use them to buy stuff."

51.name: GARY THE GADGET GUY
51.label: GARY THE GADGET GUY
51.flavor_text: "I have been conducting research on the combustion of hydrogen and oxygen," Gary continues. "Jet pack fuel is important on the island as it allows penguins to adventure."

52.name: BUOYS
52.label: BUOYS
52.flavor_text: "I'm trying to find the elusive Boo-Eee #4," replies the penguin sleuth. "They're hidden all over, and I think they're supposed to protect the island from bad weather or something."

53.name: YARR
53.label: YARR
53.flavor_text: "Me beloved best buddy Yarr has been by me side e'er since we met on Rockhopper Island," the burly captain replies. "It be a loyal friend, keepin' watch me Crow's Nest."

54.name: KLUTZY THE CRAB
54.label: KLUTZY THE CRAB
54.flavor_text: Klutzy: "CLICK CLICK CLICK."Crab Translator 3000: "I'm hungry."Klutzy: "CLA-CLICKA-CLICK CLICK-CLICK."Crab Translator 3000: "I'm still hungry."

55.name: HERBERT P. BEAR
55.label: HERBERT P. BEAR
55.flavor_text: "Why hello there, penguin. It is I, Herbert P. Bear, Esquire. Aren't you fortunate to have discovered my magnificent card. I am confident that you will treasure this picture."

56.name: HOT SAUCE
56.label: HOT SAUCE
56.flavor_text: "It is I, the alien Dojo master, hai ya! I will reveal to you the hidden ingredient of my pizza masterpieces... the amazing Hot Sauce – guaranteed to spice up any dish!"

57.name: SNOW CASTLE
57.label: SNOW CASTLE
57.flavor_text: "I think it took like a day and a half to make this," recalls one snow artist. "I don't really remember. I just know that we had to test to make sure penguins could walk on it."

58.name: AUNT ARCTIC
58.label: AUNT ARCTIC
58.flavor_text: "Hello! Aloha! Oi! I am so exhilarated to have my photograph taken for such a prestigious event. This is my desk, where I read the letters I receive and wrestle with writer's block."

59.name: CHRISTMAS CAROLS
59.label: CHRISTMAS CAROLS
59.flavor_text: "Ooooh eee oooooh!" sing the carolers as they practice their songs to serenade the town. During the holidays, the trees are trimmed with fresh snow and holiday cheer echoes throughout the island.

60.name: BETA PARTY
60.label: BETA PARTY
60.flavor_text: "We didn't have many decorations then – just a simple banner," explains a penguin wearing a party hat. "But we wanted to celebrate our hard work somehow, and penguins love a good party!"

61.name: HIDDEN ITEMS
61.label: HIDDEN ITEMS
61.flavor_text: "I found the hidden viking helmet!" he says, leafing through the latest issue of Penguin Style. "I'm totally going to add this to my pirate policeman outfit. What do you think?"

62.name: SECRET AGENT
62.label: SECRET AGENT
62.flavor_text: "One rule we have about being a secret agent is that you don't talk about secret agents," says the tight-billed penguin in the suit. "No other comments at this time."

63.name: SNOW SHOVEL
63.label: SNOW SHOVEL
63.flavor_text: "I never go anywhere without my trusty shovel. I know a lot of penguins prefer their drills, but I get a sense of reward using my shovel to move the snow around."

64.name: THE MIGRATOR
64.label: THE MIGRATOR
64.flavor_text: "Arrr mateys! Ye be gazin' at me good ship, the Migrator! It be a mighty ship of vim and vigor that has lasted many tumbles," replies Rockhopper. "Nary a better boat there be."

65.name: CAPTAIN ROCKHOPPER
65.label: CAPTAIN ROCKHOPPER
65.flavor_text: "Arrr... ye be gazin' at me glorious card. Ahhhh, a sight for sore eyes this fantastic photo be. It be remindin' me of many voyages across the seas with treasures seized!"

66.name: ICE CREAM
66.label: ICE CREAM
66.flavor_text: "There I am eating ice cream at the Beach again!" exclaims the penguin as she gets her beach towel ready. "Yes, it's true, ice cream and the Beach are a great pair."

67.name: MULLET
67.label: MULLET
67.flavor_text: "Penguins from far and wide come to this ice fishing hole to see if they can catch this legendary big fish. Someone told me I need bigger bait though, so I brought a pizza."

68.name: UNDERGROUND FLOOD
68.label: UNDERGROUND FLOOD
68.flavor_text: "Oh no! That crab over there tapped the glass and now there's a leak and there's water pouring out and there's going to be water everywhere what are we going to do now!?"

69.name: FLUFFY THE FISH
69.label: FLUFFY THE FISH
69.flavor_text: "Here fishy fishy fishy!" calls the red penguin. "I don't think Fluffy has ears," his friend replies. "Neither do we, but I can hear you..." "Hmmm. Guess you've got a point there."

70.name: SHARK
70.label: SHARK
70.flavor_text: "I know there's a big fish down there, but I don't think it's that one with the great big mean teeth and shark fin on top," the rookie fisherman says. "That's not Mullet, is it?"

71.name: FLOORING UPGRADE
71.label: FLOORING UPGRADE
71.description: When this is scored, Snow cannot be played next round.
71.flavor_text: "I'm rollin' out some burgundy style," says the interior decorator. "I've got some brand new igloo vibe picked out – a totally awesome empurpled cabin of chic. It's gonna be a partay!"

72.name: GADGET ROOM
72.label: GADGET ROOM
72.description: When this is played, Water cards become Fire for this round.
72.flavor_text: "This is my Gadget Room where I store the numerous inventions that I have been working on," explains Gary. "Testing is very important."

73.name: JACKHAMMER
73.label: JACKHAMMER
73.description: When this card is played, lower values win ties the next round.
73.flavor_text: "Here, I'll demonstrate how it works. You just put on your hat and start to dance," stated the construction penguin. "I'm not sure how it works. I just know that it does."

74.name: JET PACK
74.label: JET PACK
74.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Snowball card.
74.flavor_text: "And this is the Jet Pack, another invention I worked on with a team of scientists," Gary continues. "We initially had a few crash landings, but we've since stabilized the build."

75.name: THIN ICE
75.label: THIN ICE
75.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Red card.
75.flavor_text: "My favorite part of Thin Ice is the music. I want it in my igloo because I like how it goes 'beep-ba-beep-beep'. The black puffle in it looks really funny, too."

76.name: NIGHT VISION GOGGLES
76.label: NIGHT VISION GOGGLES
76.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Yellow card.
76.flavor_text: "Whoopee! I can see in the dark!" exclaims the penguin wearing fancy solar-powered black and green goggles. "Instead of black I can see all green! It's the coolest thing ever!"

77.name: MIGHTY PLUNGER
77.label: MIGHTY PLUNGER
77.description: When this is scored, your card gets +2 for the next round
77.flavor_text: "This is the invention to end all inventions. The Mighty Plunger of Might!" Says the green penguin. "With this great invention you will create mighty tremors and mighty rumbles!"

78.name: DRAGON
78.label: DRAGON
78.description: When this is scored, your Opponent's card get -2 for the next round
78.flavor_text: "Hark! Who dost approach my cavern!" growls a penguin, pretending to be a dragon. "Wherefore hast though entered mine cave! Make haste or I shall breathest fire!"

79.name: SPACE ADVENTURE
79.label: SPACE ADVENTURE
79.description: When this is scored, Water cannot be played next round.
79.flavor_text: "There is something troublesome about the computer after leaving Planet X," Captain Snow thinks to himself. "And Tin Can 3000 has been acting strange lately..."

80.name: TOUR GUIDE
80.label: TOUR GUIDE
80.description: When this is played, Fire cards become Snowball for this round.
80.flavor_text: "And over here we have the Ski Lodge, My buddy and I usually hang out and play Find Four there," the guide continues. "And if you're interested in sports, have I got the place for you..."

81.name: SLED RACING
81.label: SLED RACING
81.description: When this card is played, lower values win ties the next round.
81.flavor_text: "I can catch the sweetest air on this tube; it's awesome. I always aim for the ice because I can go so fast afterwards. Here comes another patch of ice... yeahhhhhhhhh!"

82.name: PUFFLE ROUND-UP
82.label: PUFFLE ROUND-UP
82.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Water card.
82.flavor_text: "Okay, I just need to catch a few more for the Pet Shop. Easy now... steady... steady..." says the penguin, thinking out loud. "It takes real concentration to do this!"

83.name: AC3000
83.label: AC3000
83.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Green card.
83.flavor_text: Do you have snow that just isn't cold enough? Then check out Gary's AC3000 – it's guaranteed to keep the snow in any Attic nice and cool.

84.name: SNOW GLOBE IGLOO
84.label: SNOW GLOBE IGLOO
84.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Purple card.
84.flavor_text: "Over there is my igloo. I saved up coins for the renovations at Christmas," she explains. "It's empty right now because I'm gearing up to get some new furniture."

85.name: SHADOW GUY & GAMMA GAL
85.label: SHADOW GUY & GAMMA GAL
85.description: When this is scored, your card gets +2 for the next round
85.flavor_text: "It looks like Squidzoid's out to eat the city again, Gamma Gal," smirks Shadow Guy. "It must have forgotten about our super powers... Let's show 'em what we're made of!"

86.name: AVALANCHE
86.label: AVALANCHE
86.description: When this is scored, your Opponent's card get -2 for the next round
86.flavor_text: "I still remember it plain as day. There was this big rumble and all this snow came WOOOSHING down the mountain!" recalls a witness. "We couldn't go sledding for like a week!"

87.name: WATER PARTY
87.label: WATER PARTY
87.description: When this is scored, Fire cannot be played next round.
87.flavor_text: "Everyone grab your inflatable whales; it's time to slip, slide and swim!" shouts the instructor, blowing on her lifeguard whistle. "Don't forget your water balloons!"

88.name: CATCHIN' WAVES
88.label: CATCHIN' WAVES
88.description: When this is played, Snowball cards become Water for this round.
88.flavor_text: "I'm still a bit shaky on this board. I wiped out constantly last time I went out," explains a slightly nervous new surfer. "I don't get how other penguins handle Survival mode!"

89.name: FIREFIGHTER
89.label: FIREFIGHTER
89.description: When this card is played, lower values win ties the next round.
89.flavor_text: "Whew, it's been a really busy day putting out fires at the Cove," wheezes the out-of-break firefighter. "That's why it's important to love what you do."

90.name: AQUA GRABBER
90.label: AQUA GRABBER
90.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Fire card.
90.flavor_text: "I've taken the Aqua Grabber out on many deep sea salvage missions," proclaims the purple penguin. "My pink puffle helps me find the really rare treasures."

91.name: OCTOPUS
91.label: OCTOPUS
91.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Blue card.
91.flavor_text: The origin of the mythical giant octopus is unknown. "I remember it like it was last year. All of a sudden, there was a big octopus... like an OCTIZILLA in the Dojo!" recalls one penguin.

92.name: CACTUS
92.label: CACTUS
92.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Orange card.
92.flavor_text: "We had to ship these here cacti in from way out west," remarks the cowpenguin. "We hadta be careful with these here spiky things, though – they got a real bite to 'em!"

93.name: TIPPING THE ICEBERG
93.label: TIPPING THE ICEBERG
93.description: When this is scored, your card gets +2 for the next round
93.flavor_text: "I had this amazing dream. In it I was at the 'berg and when I started drilling, the ice started tipping! Penguins were like 'AAH!' and I was like 'KAZAM!' It was awesome!"

94.name: NINJA
94.label: NINJA
94.description: When this is scored, your Opponent's card get -2 for the next round
94.flavor_text: "To be as the moon amongst the shadows, one must follow the code of honor and loyalty. Each movement must be as precise as a dance. Patience is both rewarded and a reward."

1.name: WHITE PUFFLE
1.label: WHITE PUFFLE
1.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Yellow card.
1.flavor_text: Close your eyes and picture... A crisp snowflake. A single sheet of blank paper. A simple pearl. A white puffle. You see, small things can sometimes conceal great power and majesty.

2.name: Yarr
2.label: Yarr
2.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Snowball card.
2.flavor_text: "Avast!" cries Rockhopper. "What be them flares me sees on the horizon? What's that ye say, Yarr? Arr, I think it be a message from me buddies at Club Penguin, too."

3.name: KEEPER OF THE BOILER ROOM
3.label: KEEPER OF THE BOILER ROOM
3.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Green card.
3.flavor_text: "Talk about an incredible job," the Keeper exclaims in the middle of a bounce. "Everyday dancing required and a cheerful nature a must..."

4.name: BLAST
4.label: BLAST
4.flavor_text: "Dude. Soooo love the shades. They make me even stronger and more silent. Maybe later we can hang out and I'll eat a Puffle O to entertain 'ya."

5.name: FLARE
5.label: FLARE
5.flavor_text: "So you think this is fast? Well, you should see how I move when I get shot from a cannon! It's a riot! And I think, actually, it increases happiness levels."

6.name: CHIRP
6.label: CHIRP
6.flavor_text: "Paints, creativity, and music," Chirp replies with whimsy. "Mix those together and you've got a masterpiece, my friends, a masterpiece!"

7.name: POP
7.label: POP
7.flavor_text: "I love bubbles more than anything else! They're beautiful to blow. Bouncy. Breathtaking. Brilliant. Transparent, floating perfection, I say! And yet, they are brief! One pop and they're gone forever."

8.name: LOOP
8.label: LOOP
8.flavor_text: "Hmm... I wonder if my lasso would work the same under water. I mean, it'd be super cool to see if I could round up some pearls, wouldn't it?"

9.name: FLIT
9.label: FLIT
9.flavor_text: "Um, nope! Can't touch this propeller hat," Flit laughs loudly. "It takes tons of practice... Even I need it! Recall Christmas 2008 when I got stuck sideways in a tree?!"

10.name: BOUNCER
10.label: BOUNCER
10.flavor_text: "It's so cool to bounce around like my ball," he declares. "By the way... it rolled under a ginormous pile of snow and though I'm small, round and can roll, I'm a bit too puffy. Can you help?"

11.name: ED MCCOOL AND DESTRUCTO
11.label: ED MCCOOL AND DESTRUCTO
11.flavor_text: "Dear Diary... Met two very talented puffles on an important PSA mission today. Will have to keep an eye out for them in the future. They may come in handy..."

12.name: NIBLET
12.label: NIBLET
12.flavor_text: "From this snowman emerges the almighty Niblet, the might green puffle! He's been trying to become a white puffle by hiding in the snow."

13.name: SNOWY NIGHT
13.label: SNOWY NIGHT
13.flavor_text: Penguins and puffles never get tired of the snow falling in Club Penguin. Best friends like to take some timeout from their busy life to watch it fall together.

14.name: PUFFLES ON THE LOOSE
14.label: PUFFLES ON THE LOOSE
14.flavor_text: Sometimes rounding up puffles feels a little like chasing a rainbow. Lots of different colors, but the closer you get the further away it seems.

15.name: CADENCE AND THE KEEPER
15.label: CADENCE AND THE KEEPER
15.flavor_text: "Yeah, this little green guy is an epic win," Cadence grinned. "He's got all the right moves. He usually knows where the party's at. He's definitely a Keeper, lolz!"

16.name: GOLDEN PUFFLE
16.label: GOLDEN PUFFLE
16.flavor_text: Such a popular myth, that they made a Stage play all about finding it. Does this shiny puffle really live under the 'berg? No one knows the truth behind the rumours....

17.name: METEOR PUFFLE
17.label: METEOR PUFFLE
17.flavor_text: Swoosh! The mysterious meteor puffle flies through the air with the greatest of ease... one minute it's there and the next... POOOOF! Gone in a flash!

18.name: RAINBOW PUFFLE
18.label: RAINBOW PUFFLE
18.flavor_text: Is this a multi-colored living legend, or just a creative little yellow puffle who has been having a bit of fun with some paint? You decide!

19.name: ABOMINABLE SNOW PUFFLE
19.label: ABOMINABLE SNOW PUFFLE
19.flavor_text: "I'm telling ya, it was absolutely massive! At least twice the size of a penguin and it had these huge claws like a crab. I was shaking in my snow boots!"

1.name: Club Penguin Times
1.label: Club Penguin Times
1.flavor_text: "Extra! Extra! Every Thursday the Club Penguin Times delivers the latest scoop on everything that's happening on the island. From fun art to stories to games, there's something new every week!"

2.name: Can of Worms
2.label: Can of Worms
2.flavor_text: Anyone who's planning to go ice fishing behind the Ski Lodge needs a can of worms. Having this squirmy bait ready is the first step to catching a fishy treat.

3.name: Winter Fiesta Party
3.label: Winter Fiesta Party
3.flavor_text: "I was at the first Winter Fiesta way back in 2007," she explained. "I missed the one in 2008, so I was totally stoked to see it again in 2009!

4.name: Invisible Ninja Suit
4.label: Invisible Ninja Suit
4.flavor_text: "The Invisibility Suit is one of the tools of the ninja. Available only from the Martial Artworks store, it allows ninja to vanish into the shadows. Useful AND cool."

5.name: Penguin Mail
5.label: Penguin Mail
5.flavor_text: Through rain, sleet, and snow, the Penguin Mail will always get through. But mostly through snow... and actually they've never seen rain, but still.

6.name: Bumble Bee
6.label: Bumble Bee
6.flavor_text: "This is my favorite Halloween costume, the Bumble Bee! I picked this one up last year when they were on sale at the Gift Shop."

7.name: Pizzatron 3000
7.label: Pizzatron 3000
7.flavor_text: Making pizzas in the Pizza Parlor can be tricky. Chefs need a steady hand and concentration of steel to prepare pizza pies perfectly for all their hungry costumers!

8.name: Card-Jitsu
8.label: Card-Jitsu
8.flavor_text: To become a ninja, one must first learn to master the elements. It all begins with Card-Jitsu, and this card you hold in your hand. Proceed to the Dojo, and take your first step on a legendary path...

9.name: Adopt-A-Puffle
9.label: Adopt-A-Puffle
9.flavor_text: Puffles are the cute little furballs you see penguins waddling around with next to them. You can even take them into games like Aqua Grabber! Drop by the Pet Shop in the Plaza to adopt one of your very own.

10.name: Rock & Roll Suit
10.label: Rock & Roll Suit
10.flavor_text: This trendy outfit is popular for its sparkle and "pizzazz!" It was first released in the Gift Shop, just before Music Jam '08, one of the biggest parties of the year.

11.name: Construction
11.label: Construction
11.flavor_text: "There's construction going on all over the place in Club Penguin all the time. Penguins on the island love to build and create, so construction is a pretty popular job around here!"

12.name: Hidden Pins
12.label: Hidden Pins
12.flavor_text: "These charming, limited edition collector's items are a must have for any treasure hunter... a brand new one is hidden every two weeks somewhere on the island!"

13.name: Treasure Hunt Game
13.label: Treasure Hunt Game
13.flavor_text: "Rockhopper's Treasure Hunt game is kinda rare. You can only play it when his ship, the Migrator, is docked on the Beach. Remember, you need his key from that book to get into the Quarters on the ship.

14.name: DJ3K
14.label: DJ3K
14.flavor_text: DJ3K at the Night Club is a music-makin' penguin's favorite game. "It's simple, yo. Just start pushin' buttons and the groove kicks in. Every good beat needs a little cowbell, so I like to mix that into my sets."

15.name: Surf Boards
15.label: Surf Boards
15.flavor_text: "The only thing you need to 'catch some waves' down at the Cove; penguins can borrow a board or buy their own at the Surf Shack. Then they just need to catch a 'gnarly' wave and 'hang ten!'"

16.name: Beach Chair Chilling
16.label: Beach Chair Chilling
16.flavor_text: "Chilling out" at the Beach is even easier when the beach is made of snow. Sun glasses are optional, but you add that touch of "cool" while you "chill."

17.name: Telescope
17.label: Telescope
17.flavor_text: "If you look through the telescope at the Beacon, you can see all the way out to sea. It's a good place to keep a close eye out for Rockhopper."

18.name: Fish Costume
18.label: Fish Costume
18.flavor_text: "Don't give me that look..." said the penguin. "It's just a costume. I'm trying to get a part in a play at the Stage, and I need expert advice. Now are you going to help me or not?"

19.name: Crow's Nest
19.label: Crow's Nest
19.flavor_text: Yarr's favorite place on the Migrator is up in the Crow's Net. You can see for miles, and take out any rogue icebergs with the ship's snowball cannon.

20.name: The Cove
20.label: The Cove
20.flavor_text: "Other penguins like to come to the Cove to surf, but I just love to gaze out at the water. I was the first one to spot a huge storm one time through the binoculars! The ocean can tell you a lot."

21.name: Captain's Quarters
21.label: Captain's Quarters
21.flavor_text: "Rockhopper used to keep his quarters locked," the tour guide says. "But now you just need to find his key to get in..."

22.name: Iceberg
22.label: Iceberg
22.flavor_text: "If we tipped this over, what do you think we'd find on the other side?" one penguin inquires. "It's the biggest mystery of all," they replied. "We've got to find a way to tip it.

23.name: The Lounge
23.label: The Lounge
23.flavor_text: The Lounge is located upstairs from the Night Club, and it's the perfect place to "chill" and play arcade games. Can you master the tricky "Thin Ice" or pilot the "Astro Barrier" to victory?

24.name: Rockhopper's Key
24.label: Rockhopper's Key
24.flavor_text: "Arr! Ye be needin' this special key to get into me Captain's Quarters on me good ship the Migrator!" Rockhopper chuckled. "I hid it somewhere on the island. Ye might want to "book" some time to find it..."

25.name: Penguins That Time Forgot
25.label: Penguins That Time Forgot
25.flavor_text: "Dinosaurs, lava, time-traveling... this was one of my favorite plays," she explained. "Watch this, I'll be a cave penguin... 'GRUB! FIRE ROAST MARSHMALLOW!'"

26.name: Team Blue Rally
26.label: Team Blue Rally
26.flavor_text: Rallying at the Stage for epic competitions, the Red Team and Blue Team wrote another chapter of their rivalry with the introduction of their moose mascots.

27.name: Jet Pack Adventure
27.label: Jet Pack Adventure
27.flavor_text: "For those looking to experience the thrill of flying, look no further than Jet Pack Adventure," said the Tour Guide. "Just head to the top of the Lighthouse, strap on a pack, and take off! Parachutes provided!"

28.name: Ruby and the Ruby
28.label: Ruby and the Ruby
28.flavor_text: "See, here's the shimmy – this classy lady named Ruby had lost her ruby. A victim of poetic irony, I know. She needed my help, and she needed it fast..." -Jacques Hammer

29.name: Snowball Fight
29.label: Snowball Fight
29.flavor_text: Snowballs can be used for all types of purposes, from snowball fights to tennis matches. "I like to throw rapid-fire by hitting 'T' on my keyboard constantly. TURBO THROW!"

30.name: Snowball Press
30.label: Snowball Press
30.flavor_text: "The Snowball Press publishes all the great books Club Penguin has to offer, like Rockhopper's Journal and Penguin Tales. Check 'em out in the room above the Coffee Shop. Remember: every word counts!"

31.name: Music Jam
31.label: Music Jam
31.flavor_text: "I love a good music festival," he responded. "Music Jam 2008 was probably my favorite party. I finally got to meet Penguin Band, and DJ3K came out for the first time!"

32.name: Puffle Chew-Chew
32.label: Puffle Chew-Chew
32.flavor_text: "My black puffle just loves the scratching post I bought him from the Pet Shop. But I can't figure out why he keeps trying to eat it! Maybe I need to feed him some Puffle O's."

33.name: Fairy Fables
33.label: Fairy Fables
33.flavor_text: "My fave play's definitely Fairy Fables, cuz it's got the Big Bad Wool costume in it. I wear the sheep costume and my buddy dresses up like the prince from the story and we make up our own plays in the Forest."

34.name: Jelly Fish
34.label: Jelly Fish
34.flavor_text: These rare Antarctic jelly fish can produce a small electric charge that can make for a 'shocking' experience for Ice Fishing experts who may snag one on their line.

35.name: Pirate
35.label: Pirate
35.flavor_text: "Arr! Only the bravest penguins join me pirate crew!" says Rockhopper. "Smartly now, sailors – where be yer sea flippers?"

36.name: Fish Bait
36.label: Fish Bait
36.flavor_text: The fish around Club Penguin won't just up and eat and old bait. In fact, each kind of fish has their own favorite food. Fishing experts recommend trying different types of bait for best results.

37.name: Hydro Hopper
37.label: Hydro Hopper
37.flavor_text: "Catchin' a ride on the ol' Hydro Hopper at the Dock is sweet," the Tour Guide explained. "Catching air and sailing over obstacles is not only fun, but will earn you extra coins. Come on, give it a try!"

38.name: Puffle O's
38.label: Puffle O's
38.flavor_text: "Though puffles enjoy cookies, and a stick of gum now and then, their favorite food is Puffle O's, without a doubt," said the Puffle Handler. "Make sure not to overfeed them though, because they might get a tummy ache."

39.name: Fall Fair Games
39.label: Fall Fair Games
39.flavor_text: "Once a year the Fall Fair comes to Club Penguin with a whole bunch of special games," said the Tour Guide. "These games award tickets you can trade for sweet prizes. And I mean 'sweet.' Their cotton candy is delicious!"

40.name: Thinga-ma-jig 3000
40.label: Thinga-ma-jig 3000
40.flavor_text: "Oh, you've heard of the Thing-ma-jig 3000?" Gary asked. "Oh yes, it's quite a clever little device, but it's hidden away in my Gadget Room. It's so well hidden in that you'd have to be some kind of secret agent to find it."

41.name: Rad Scientist
41.label: Rad Scientist
41.flavor_text: This unique Halloween costume first appeared in October 2008, when Gary the Gadget Guy was working on the Monster Maker 3000 invention in his secret lab. "Spookalicious!"

42.name: Quip and Qua
42.label: Quip and Qua
42.flavor_text: "Truly we are the most bizarre costumes that can be purchased from the Stage..." scoffed Qua. "I don't know..." answered Quip. "I saw a squid monster with a sheep face walking around." "Well," replies Qua, "other than that guy..."

43.name: Twee
43.label: Twee
43.flavor_text: The fairy storyteller from the Fairy Fables play at the Stage. Twee loves to mix things up to keep it fresh – from colors to stories, things are never quite ordinary in her library!

44.name: Coins For Change
44.label: Coins For Change
44.flavor_text: "They say it's better to give than to receive and that's totally tree with Coins for Change. There's always amazing amounts of generosity when penguins decide to change the world! Waddle around and make difference!"

45.name: Surfing with the Sharks
45.label: Surfing with the Sharks
45.flavor_text: "And I was like, woah, it's a shark! And it was like 'RAH!' and then I was like whoa, it's a shark! And you shoulda seen it man. I mean, it was huge – it was mahoosive!"

46.name: Dance Contest
46.label: Dance Contest
46.flavor_text: "Any penguin brave enough to stand up, talk the talk, walk the walk, and bust out their icy best moves is an epic win here in the Dance Club."

47.name: Purple Octopus
47.label: Purple Octopus
47.flavor_text: "What's wackier than an octopus showing up in the middle of a party? Nothing! That's epic wacky! This inflatable octopus tends to show up at the strangest of times, so keep your eyes open for other appearances!"

48.name: Giant Squid
48.label: Giant Squid
48.flavor_text: "I'm telling you, the Squid is totally real. I was deep below the Iceberg in the Aqua Grabber one day when it went zipping past me going 'EAAAUUUUURGGGGH!'. We need to find it!"

49.name: Penguin Band
49.label: Penguin Band
49.description: When this is played, Water cards become Fire for this round.
49.flavor_text: G Billy, Petey K, Stompin' Bob and Franky... these four penguins sure know how to rock it out. They get together whenever a Music Jam party is happening and sign autographs for their devoted fans.

50.name: Dojo Sketch
50.label: Dojo Sketch
50.description: When this is scored, Snow cannot be played next round.
50.flavor_text: On  April Fool's Day, the penguins were startled. But Sensei reassured: "Pencil Dojo is serene, calm, smart, very cool just like this haiku."

51.name: Flare Flinger 3000
51.label: Flare Flinger 3000
51.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Red card.
51.flavor_text: "I can't wait for Rockhopper to see how we've restored the Migrator to her former glory," commented one penguin as she loaded up the Flare Flinger 3000.

52.name: Herbert & Klutzy
52.label: Herbert & Klutzy
52.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Orange card.
52.flavor_text: "I don't know about you, but I really DIG this drill a HOLE lot! HAHAHA! What do you think Klutzy?" Click. Click click. "What do you mean 'bearly'?"

53.name: Coffee Delivery Truck
53.label: Coffee Delivery Truck
53.description: When this is scored, Water cannot be played next round.
53.flavor_text: "To the left a bit, no, to the right, aah, watch the fish!" yells the delivery guy. "Hey, what's the guy up front doing anyway? And who puts anvils in a delivery truck?"

54.name: Anniversary Party
54.label: Anniversary Party
54.description: When this is played, Fire cards become Snowball for this round.
54.flavor_text: "If there's one thing we know how to do around here, it's partying! One party I rarely miss is Club Penguin's anniversary every October 24. There's cake, balloons, and of course, cool party hats!"

55.name: Halloween Party
55.label: Halloween Party
55.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Water card.
55.flavor_text: "Every year, on a dark and spooky night, penguins from all over the island dress up as ghosts, monsters and even bumble bees. Then they go out trick or treating. Halloween is definitely the strangest time of year!"

56.name: Sensei
56.label: Sensei
56.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Purple card.
56.flavor_text: The wisest penguin, knows every journey begins, with a single step. They should also know, that if you speak in haiku, you sound really wise.

57.name: Jackhammers
57.label: Jackhammers
57.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Blue card.
57.flavor_text: "This amazing marvel of penguin mechanics is the tool of choice for construction projects around the island. Just grab a hard hat, and make like you're going to dance. The jackhammer will do the rest."

58.name: Quest for the Golden Puffle
58.label: Quest for the Golden Puffle
58.description: When this is scored, Fire cannot be played next round.
58.flavor_text: "Since the beginning of time, penguins have been searching for the legendary Golden Puffle..." said the Tour Guide. "There's even a play at the Stage based on this mysterious myth. Is it real? Will we ever find out?"

59.name: Storm
59.label: Storm
59.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Fire card.
59.flavor_text: "AAHH! What if there's a lot of wind?" "What if there's extra snow?" "What if the sky pours out pounds of candy?!"

60.name: Rockhopper
60.label: Rockhopper
60.description: When this is played, Snowball cards become Water for this round.
60.flavor_text: "Arr, me hearties! Ahoy! Stand smartly sailors, for you be in the company of the fearless Captain Rockhopper, the best pirate that ever sailed the seven seas. Me and Yarr be hoping to see ye all soon! Arr harr!"

1.name: Camera
1.label: Camera
1.flavor_text: This item is sometimes found in the Costume Trunk at the Stage. Once you have a camera, wave to snap award-winning photos all over the island.

2.name: Wigs
2.label: Wigs
2.flavor_text: All wigs can be found in Penguin Style catalog in the Gift Shop. Every penguin should have one – from punk to surfer – they really complete an outfit!

3.name: Pizza Parlor
3.label: Pizza Parlor
3.flavor_text: Be a chef! Make pizzas in the Pizzatron 3000 game in the kitchen. Put on your red apron and dance to serve customers in the restaurant.

4.name: Coffee Machine
4.label: Coffee Machine
4.flavor_text: Secret Agents will find this machine in the Coffee Shop during the Secret of the Fur mission. It will help you save the island.

5.name: Costume Trunk
5.label: Costume Trunk
5.flavor_text: You'll find this at the Stage – and it's never empty! Open it and choose an outfit. You could be a brave explorer, a scientist, a lobster, a hero, a time traveler... anything you want!

6.name: Pet Shop Staff
6.label: Pet Shop Staff
6.flavor_text: The employees in the Pet shop love looking after puffles! With the orange apron on, you can dance to serve them food. Look for it from time to time in Penguin Style.

7.name: Stompin' Bob
7.label: Stompin' Bob
7.flavor_text: The laid back bass player of Penguin Band. He keeps the beat with bandmate G Billy and loves to play the jazzy stuff.

8.name: G Billy
8.label: G Billy
8.flavor_text: The founder of and drummer for Penguin Band. If you ever get the chance to meet him Backstage during Music Jam be sure to get an autographed background by clicking his player card!

9.name: Outdoor Igloo
9.label: Outdoor Igloo
9.flavor_text: Penguins with outdoor areas for their igloos can throw amazing parties. Check out Better Igloos for cool furniture, like this BBQ. Oh the gnome? Every party should have one!

10.name: Ticket Booth
10.label: Ticket Booth
10.flavor_text: You never know who will sell you a ticket for the latest Stage performance at the Plaza. Sometimes actors man the booth between shows!

11.name: Ridge Run
11.label: Ridge Run
11.flavor_text: It's the toughest Sled Racing run on the Ski Hill. Up to four penguins can race together, so if you're serious about challenging your buddies, this is the way to do it!

12.name: Clock Tower
12.label: Clock Tower
12.flavor_text: Ready, set, throw snow! Find this snowball-powered clock in the Snow Forts. Throw snowballs at the target to help keep it powered. Just press T on your keyboard and click the red target!

13.name: White Puffles
13.label: White Puffles
13.flavor_text: First discovered in February '09, these critters are known to be gentle but powerful. Adopt one from the Pet Shop and discover what it can turn to ice with a single breath!

14.name: Dojo Courtyard
14.label: Dojo Courtyard
14.flavor_text: This is the outside of the Dojo and it was uncovered by penguins in November 2008. To get here, you must use your map.

15.name: Rocking Horse
15.label: Rocking Horse
15.flavor_text: This ginormous rocking horse somehow found itself upstairs in the Lodge Attic. To see it for yourself, go to the Ski Village and climb the ladder inside the Ski Lodge.

16.name: Penguin Style
16.label: Penguin Style
16.flavor_text: There's new stuff in this catalog every month! Why not get your friends together in the Gift Shop and check it out? Pick out new outfits, then hold a fashion show in your igloo!

17.name: Stage Director
17.label: Stage Director
17.flavor_text: Directors needed! Located in the Plaza, the Stage has new plays every month and always needs actors, stagehands, and even directors to make every performance a success. Grab a costume from the catalog and break a leg!

18.name: Conductor
18.label: Conductor
18.flavor_text: This outfit showed up in the Penguin Style during Music Jam. When penguins put it on and danced, they conducted orchestras all over the island.

19.name: Beacon
19.label: Beacon
19.flavor_text: From the top of the Lighthouse, you can look through the telescope to see if there's sign of Rockhopper's ship or play the game Jet Pack Adventure.

20.name: Discovering The Underground
20.label: Discovering The Underground
20.flavor_text: There's two secret passages to the underground. You'll find this one in the Plaza. To find the other passage, head to the room with the best beats and pay attention to the speaker on the far right.

21.name: Franky
21.label: Franky
21.flavor_text: This cool lead guitarist of Penguin Band loves to hang out with other music fans around the island. Find him with his bandmates Backstage during Music Jam and receive an autographed background.

22.name: Petey K.
22.label: Petey K.
22.flavor_text: The talented pianist and accordion player in the Penguin Band. He's always bursting with new song ideas and loves to share them with audiences around the island.

23.name: Boombox
23.label: Boombox
23.flavor_text: Penguins learned a new dance with this item when Cadence showed up with it during a party in the Night Club. If you have the item, wear it and press D on your keyboard and see what you can do!

24.name: Mild Mannered Reporter
24.label: Mild Mannered Reporter
24.flavor_text: This character appears in Shadow Guy and Gamma Gal vs. Squidzoid at the Stage. He's a bit of a shy guy, but he's just as important as the ones with the super powers!

25.name: The Twelfth Fish
25.label: The Twelfth Fish
25.flavor_text: Appearing at the Stage Dec. 2007, this Shakespearean style comedy starred a Bard, a Countess, a Jester and (obviously) a Fish who couldn't stop blubbing. "BUT NEVER DOUBT I BLUB!"

26.name: April Fool's Day Party
26.label: April Fool's Day Party
26.flavor_text: It's a celebration where things happen that can't happen! Discover the wacky and unexpected with friends across the island at this party – from surprise-filled boxes to new dimensions!

27.name: Plasma Glow Wave
27.label: Plasma Glow Wave
27.flavor_text: You can light up the Stage with Gamma Gal's incredible Plasma Glow Wave during every performance of Shadow Guy and Gamma Gal vs. Squidzoid. Wear the costume and wave to activate the special power.

28.name: Cowbell
28.label: Cowbell
28.flavor_text: First available at the Music Jam '09 party, this item is still a hit across the island! To join in the fun, press D on your keyboard while wearing the item.

29.name: O Berry Bush
29.label: O Berry Bush
29.flavor_text: Puffles love them and it's a good thing too! When they get hungry it's the best meal to recharge their energy. O'Berries grow in the wild and are always in full supply on your puffle's player card.

30.name: Chester The Time Traveler
30.label: Chester The Time Traveler
30.flavor_text: In Penguins that Time Forgot at the Stage, this curious character finds himself on an adventure back in time surrounded by dinosaurs and cave penguins.

31.name: 101 Days of Fun
31.label: 101 Days of Fun
31.flavor_text: There's always a lot to discover around the island and in 2009, for 101 days straight, penguins had fun completing a new activity every day!

32.name: Color Vote
32.label: Color Vote
32.flavor_text: The 2009 color vote was an epic battle between Lavender, Maroon and Aqua. Penguins voted in the Forest and the winning color was added to the Penguin Style catalog as a new penguin color.

33.name: Christmas Party
33.label: Christmas Party
33.flavor_text: Holiday spirit takes over the island during this party! This is the Photo Booth in the Forest where penguins posed for pictures with Santa.

34.name: Viking Opera
34.label: Viking Opera
34.flavor_text: Be part of this popular Stage show, as a detective, ghost, or even the Viking Opera singer. Put on the Viking wig and dance, following along to the script.

35.name: Water Balloons
35.label: Water Balloons
35.flavor_text: Most penguins have had a snowball fight at the Snow Forts. But at the Water Party, the splat of water balloons replacing the thud of snow. Too cool!

36.name: Tuba
36.label: Tuba
36.flavor_text: At the Music Jam '09 party, this item was popular at the Lighthouse stage. When you wore it and danced, you could even hear it playing!

37.name: Rockhopper's Plants
37.label: Rockhopper's Plants
37.flavor_text: The captain of the Migrator brought these plants to the island in 2009. Penguins put them in their igloos and they started to grow! Every few weeks they change – even to this day!

38.name: Adventure Party
38.label: Adventure Party
38.flavor_text: During this June 2009 party, after Rockhopper's plants took over the island, penguin explorers discovered rare flowers – some that changed colors and others that liked to eat snowballs!

39.name: Penguin Play Awards
39.label: Penguin Play Awards
39.flavor_text: Penguins called this one of 2009's coolest events. They voted for their favorite stage plays, got to meet Penguin Band and Aunt Arctic, and enjoyed dressing up to receive their own awards!

40.name: All-Access Pass
40.label: All-Access Pass
40.flavor_text: During Music Jam '09 party, this pass got penguins into the Backstage and Night Club Rooftop where they hung out with friends and had a chance to meet Penguin Band and Cadence.

41.name: Cadence's Autograph
41.label: Cadence's Autograph
41.flavor_text: Cadence is a very popular penguin around here! She makes appearances at big events like the Penguin Play Awards. You can meet her and receive an autographed background by clicking her player card.

42.name: Treasure Book
42.label: Treasure Book
42.flavor_text: This book contains the best collection of rare and exclusive items. Look for a code with select toys and enter at clubpenguin.com to gain access to this special catalog.

43.name: Black Hoodie
43.label: Black Hoodie
43.flavor_text: You might spot more than a few penguins wearing this popular item. When it appears in Penguin Style, the Gift Shop always has plenty in stock!

44.name: Propellor Cap
44.label: Propellor Cap
44.flavor_text: Penguins flew for the first time when they danced while wearing this item at the 2006 April Fool's Day Party. Penguins aren't the only ones who like these caps though – check out the green puffles!

45.name: Dessert Pizza
45.label: Dessert Pizza
45.flavor_text: One of the island's best kept secrets. Make Dessert Pizza in the Pizza Parlor's Pizzatron 3000 game by clicking on the lever of the machine when you enter the game!

46.name: Black Electric Guitar
46.label: Black Electric Guitar
46.flavor_text: This limited edition instrument is available from the Penguin Style catalog in the Gift Shop from time to time. To play it, put it on and dance. Go solo or join a band!

47.name: Mastering The Elements
47.label: Mastering The Elements
47.flavor_text: Fire. Snow. Water. That's what you'll need to master the Card-Jitsu game. Train with your friends and Sensei at the Dojo to earn belts and become a ninja.

48.name: Elite Penguin Force
48.label: Elite Penguin Force
48.flavor_text: This super-secret agency has one goal: to protect the Club Pengun island. Their base, the Command Room, is hidden near the Ski Village.

49.name: Switchbox 3000
49.label: Switchbox 3000
49.description: When this is scored, discard all Opponent's Red cards.
49.flavor_text: One of Gary the Gadget Guy's inventions, this special FX box is found at the Stage. Every switch, button and lever changes the set in a different way.

50.name: Medieval Party
50.label: Medieval Party
50.description: When this is scored, discard all Opponent's Blue cards.
50.flavor_text: During the Medieval Party penguins discovered dragons, befriended knights and completed heroic quests.

51.name: Cadence
51.label: Cadence
51.description: When this is scored, your Opponent's card get -2 for the next round
51.flavor_text: Cadence is a popular DJ and she loves to dance. She opened the Night Club's Dance Contest game  in 2009, where you can challenge your friends or dance solo.

52.name: Cloud Wave
52.label: Cloud Wave
52.description: When this is scored, discard all Opponent's Green cards.
52.flavor_text: Pick up the  Cloud Wave Bracer from the Martial Artworks catalog in the Ninja Hideout. Wear them and dance to create mysterious clouds before you turn invisible!

53.name: Ghost Sheet
53.label: Ghost Sheet
53.description: When this is scored, your Opponent's card get -2 for the next round
53.flavor_text: You can find this costume in the Gift Shop at Halloween or in the Costume Trunk while Haunting of the Viking Opera is on at the Stage. During the play, this outfit certainly scared the singers!

54.name: Cart Surfer
54.label: Cart Surfer
54.description: When this is scored, discard all Opponent's Purple cards.
54.flavor_text: The gnarly game can be found in the Mine, where your surf & skate tricks will earn you coins! Hang on for a wild surf ride!

55.name: Keytar
55.label: Keytar
55.description: When this is scored, discard all Opponent's Orange cards.
55.flavor_text: This Treasure Book instrument is a musical masterpiece! It's pretty rare and you just have to put it on and dance to rock!

56.name: X-treme Jetpack
56.label: X-treme Jetpack
56.description: When this is scored, your card gets +2 for the next round
56.flavor_text: You'll see  this penguin in the Comics on the community section of the website. He's always looking for a new challenge to take games to the next level – the X-treme!

57.name: Box Dimension
57.label: Box Dimension
57.description: When this is scored, your card gets +2 for the next round
57.flavor_text: Penguins can enter this room through the Portal Box item when it is set up in an igloo. This item was available at the 2009 April Fool's Day Party.

58.name: Gold Viking Helmet
58.label: Gold Viking Helmet
58.description: When this is scored, discard all Opponent's Yellow cards.
58.flavor_text: This item is super rare! It's only available once in a while and is usually hidden as a secret in the Penguin Style catalog.

59.name: Gary The Gadget Guy
59.label: Gary The Gadget Guy
59.description: When this is scored, your card gets +2 for the next round
59.flavor_text: Gary is the island's resident inventor. He generally prefers to keep to himself to concentrate on inventing new gadgets. You may have seen a few like the Jet Pack and Pizzatron 3000.

60.name: Rockhopper's Cannon
60.label: Rockhopper's Cannon
60.description: When this is scored, your Opponent's card get -2 for the next round
60.flavor_text: "ARR! Me Migrator's mighty cannon is known for many things. Its snowballs defend against icebergs. But in the past, it's also launched cake, candles and even me Puffle, Yarr!"

1.name: Multi-Player
1.label: Multi-Player
1.flavor_text: Battle up to 3 other ninjas in Card-Jitsu Fire, the ultimate test of speed and power. Land on an element, play your cards and the highest number will win.

2.name: Fire Battle
2.label: Fire Battle
2.flavor_text: Skilled ninjas show their mastery of the element of fire, battling with hot sauce. They never spill a drop on their ninja suit and they don't fear it on their pizza.

3.name: Fired Up
3.label: Fired Up
3.flavor_text: Ninja students all over the island helped to stoke the fires of a long–dormant Volcano in the hills of Club Penguin. Even their black puffles joined in!

4.name: Goldsmith
4.label: Goldsmith
4.flavor_text: Here's a tip if you're a ninja, you can buy a Goldsmith Apron inside the Hideout (beside the Dojo). If you wear this item then dance, your penguin will forge gold!

5.name: NINJA BATTLE SCROLL
5.label: NINJA BATTLE SCROLL
5.flavor_text: Ninjas face off in a match of Card-Jitsu Fire atop the great Volcano. Each ninja student must master the element of fire to earn legendary items such as the Fire Gem.

6.name: THE VOLCANO AWAKENS
6.label: THE VOLCANO AWAKENS
6.flavor_text: This distant mountain in the hills of Club Penguin had lay dormant for years. It wasn't until September 2009 that penguins realized that is was actually a Volcano!

7.name: Prepare For Battle
7.label: Prepare For Battle
7.flavor_text: Ninjas practice their Card-Jitsu poses before pouncing into action. Here, we see a ninja preparing to go into a Card-Jitsu Fire battle, where you must play the best element card to win.

8.name: Flying Flippers Emporium
8.label: Flying Flippers Emporium
8.flavor_text: Only ninjas can access this quaint little shop at the heart of the Ninja Hideout beside the Dojo. The magical Amulet is the most popular item sold here.

9.name: CARD-JITSU FIRE DUEL
9.label: CARD-JITSU FIRE DUEL
9.flavor_text: Land on this square in a game of Card-Jitsu Fire, and you’ll face a battle against another ninja. Remember, fire beats snow, snow beats water, water beats fire.

10.name: SENSEI'S GAME FACE
10.label: SENSEI'S GAME FACE
10.flavor_text: Once you have earned all the pieces of your Fire Suit, you must challenge Sensei and win. Only then will you earn your Fire Gem to become a Fire Ninja!

11.name: Building the Entrance
11.label: Building the Entrance
11.flavor_text: Back in September 2009, construction on the entrance to the Volcano began at the Hideout. Sensei built a path to the top of the Volcano, and we worked together to build the Fire Dojo!

12.name: Amulet Inscription
12.label: Amulet Inscription
12.flavor_text: See how the fire symbol glows? Once a ninja student has mastered the element of fire, Sensei will award them with a Fire Gem. Only then will the fire symbol glow in the Ninja Hideout.

13.name: The quest for fire
13.label: The quest for fire
13.flavor_text: Sensei asked ninja students to gather fiery items from all over the island. We used these items to stoke the Volcano. It was time for our next ninja journey!

14.name: Stoking the volcano
14.label: Stoking the volcano
14.flavor_text: Ninjas gathered fiery items from all around the island to make the Volcano even hotter. It sparked great events, starting with a great storm which hit the island just before Halloween.

15.name: Fire Deck
15.label: Fire Deck
15.flavor_text: Mastered Card-Jitsu and earned your ninja mask? Then you may seek Sensei in the Fire Dojo, where he will give you this set of powerful cards.

16.name: Fire Ninja Stance
16.label: Fire Ninja Stance
16.flavor_text: Here's a hot tip if you're a Fire Ninja, wear these 4 items: Flame Sandals, Magma Coat, Lava Mask & Fiery Helmet. Then hit D on your keyboard. Behold the Fire Stance!

17.name: Ninja Sketches
17.label: Ninja Sketches
17.flavor_text: We drew these ninjas back in August 2009 while we were working up some stuff for Card-Jitsu Fire. Some of these were made into real world "pop-up" cards.

18.name: Fire Ninja Statue
18.label: Fire Ninja Statue
18.flavor_text: The powerful stone statues at the Fire Dojo watch over ninja students as they learn to master the element of fire. Beyond the mighty Fire Suit!

19.name: TUB OF HOT SAUCE
19.label: TUB OF HOT SAUCE
19.flavor_text: We aren't quite sure about this tub of hot sauce at the Fire Dojo. Is it pouring hot sauce into the Volcano, or is the lava actually hot sauce? This mystery remains...

20.name: FIRE DOJO SKETCH
20.label: FIRE DOJO SKETCH
20.flavor_text: Here's the original sketch of the Fire Dojo from May 2009. In the finished version we added a tub of hot sauce, and changed the outfit on the statue a bit!

21.name: SENSEI
21.label: SENSEI
21.flavor_text: Sensei first appeared outside the Dojo in November 2008, where he was seen digging snow with a shovel. Almost a year later, he helped awaken the great Volcano...

22.name: VOLCANO ENTRANCE SKETCH
22.label: VOLCANO ENTRANCE SKETCH
22.flavor_text: This is a sketch we drew of Sensei in front of the Volcano entrance. We made this for a scene on our website back in September 2009, but ended up never using it!

23.name: The Amulet
23.label: The Amulet
23.flavor_text: Behold the Amulet! A symbol of power and skill, and a key to mastering the element of fire. Once you have mastered the element of fire, the Fire Gem will glow![1]

24.name: Journey to the volcano
24.label: Journey to the volcano
24.flavor_text: Take the next step along the ninja path. Journey across the narrow bridge to the Fire Dojo, where you will learn to master the element of fire to become a Fire Ninja.

25.name: Volcano Entrance
25.label: Volcano Entrance
25.flavor_text: The entrance to the Volcano can only be opened by those who own the Amulet. To enter, click the stone table and uncover the hidden door to the secret Fire Dojo.

26.name: Sensei's Fire Robes
26.label: Sensei's Fire Robes
26.flavor_text: Sensei is a master of Card-Jitsu Fire. As you challenge other ninja students and earn experience, Sensei will award you with pieces of the Fire Ninja Suit.

27.name: Fire Ninja
27.label: Fire Ninja
27.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Snowball card.
27.flavor_text: To gain your  Fire Ninja Suit, you must practice Card-Jitsu Fire, then defeat the Sensei in the final challenge. Do you have what it takes to become a Fire Ninja?

1.name: Monkey King
1.label: Monkey King
1.flavor_text: A quick-thinking trickster, always ready for adventure. The Monkey King must face a great quest in the play "Secrets of the Bamboo Forest".

2.name: Jet Pack Pilot
2.label: Jet Pack Pilot
2.flavor_text: Soaring through the air at top speed, penguin pilots master the art of Jet Packing. Head to the Beacon to take off on Jet Pack Adventure!

3.name: Fairy Princess
3.label: Fairy Princess
3.flavor_text: Fairies and Princesses go together like fish and pizza. Both have been spotted during plays, Halloween, and the Medieval Party.

4.name: Puffle Grooming
4.label: Puffle Grooming
4.flavor_text: Does your puffle want to try out a new hairdo? These salon chairs first appeared during the Puffle Party 2010. They are now available in the Pet Shop.

5.name: Halloween Costumes
5.label: Halloween Costumes
5.flavor_text: Every year for Halloween, more and more costumes appear at the Gift Shop. Trick-or-treaters should not be surprised to see dragons or Franken-fairies around the island.

6.name: Costume Show
6.label: Costume Show
6.flavor_text: During the Halloween Party, penguins looking to show off their custom costumes can waddle over to the costume show. Monsters and ladybugs alike are welcome!

7.name: Soccer Match
7.label: Soccer Match
7.flavor_text: Soccer is a very popular pastime on the island. Whether two or twenty two penguins are playing, the action is always epic. Get your game on at the Stadium!

8.name: Bean Counters
8.label: Bean Counters
8.flavor_text: Unloading the Coffee Shop truck is one of the oldest jobs on the island. And as long as penguins need their coffee, the Coffee Shop will need someone to help unload the beans.

9.name: Earth Day Recycling
9.label: Earth Day Recycling
9.flavor_text: As part of the Earth Day celebration, penguins decided to help clean up the island. A new Recycling Depot was built, and everyone took part in a huge recycling scavenger hunt.

10.name: Penguin Play Awards
10.label: Penguin Play Awards
10.flavor_text: During the Penguin Play Awards, interviewers are always busy. Everyone is invited to sit in the chair and share their thoughts on the Stage plays and awards. Everyone!

11.name: Goal!
11.label: Goal!
11.flavor_text: To play soccer at the Stadium, you've got to be quick. Click on the soccer ball to run over and kick it. The faster you're going, the faster the ball will go!

12.name: Bamboo Forest Sketch
12.label: Bamboo Forest Sketch
12.flavor_text: These are sketches of characters from "Secrets of the Bamboo Forest". We drew lots of different designs for their costumes before we decided on these ones.

13.name: The Mine Cave is Safe!
13.label: The Mine Cave is Safe!
13.flavor_text: When a rockslide in the Mine revealed hidden caves, crews moved in to make them safe to explore. "We're off to a rocky start," said Rory, "but that's normal for a cave."

14.name: Mine Cave Construction
14.label: Mine Cave Construction
14.flavor_text: Revealed by a rockslide in January of 2010, this dark cave is a construction worker's dream. Penguins can mine for gold with jackhammers, or help keep the lights powered with snowballs.

15.name: Guardian Dog
15.label: Guardian Dog
15.flavor_text: This costume from "Secrets of the Bamboo Forest" gives you the power to turn into a statue. Just press 'W' on your keyboard! The perfect skill for patient guardians...

16.name: The Fair
16.label: The Fair
16.flavor_text: Every September, penguins look forward to the island's famous Fair. There are many special games, prizes and shows to see... so step right up!

17.name: Hockey Gear
17.label: Hockey Gear
17.flavor_text: Hockey players can find all their equipment in the Snow and Sports catalog at the Stadium. The proper gear is important before stepping onto the ice.

18.name: Puffle Show
18.label: Puffle Show
18.flavor_text: The Puffle Show premiered during the Puffle Party in 2010. Penguins took their furry friends there to compete in an exciting obstacle course.

19.name: Holiday Gifts
19.label: Holiday Gifts
19.flavor_text: During the Holiday Party in 2009, a special postcard allowed penguins to send a gift to their friends. Wrapped inside each was a Candy Cane Hat.

20.name: Holiday Activities
20.label: Holiday Activities
20.flavor_text: Even during the colder months, many penguins enjoy bundling up and playing in the snow. Making snowmen, caroling and snowball fights are very popular activities during this time.

21.name: Stadium
21.label: Stadium
21.flavor_text: The Stadium was upgraded to allow bigger crows to attend hockey and soccer games. Complete with bleachers, new lighting and booths for food vendors.

22.name: Igloo Items
22.label: Igloo Items
22.flavor_text: Nothing spruces up an igloo like a few items from the Better Igloos catalog. Puffles especially love it when there are lots of things to play with.

23.name: Music Jam
23.label: Music Jam
23.flavor_text: Music Jam is the island's annual music festival. It's all about finding the right styles, sounds and moves to express yourself.

24.name: Elite Penguin Sketch
24.label: Elite Penguin Sketch
24.flavor_text: This sketch shows an Elite Agent locating his Field-Op. We wanted to show the Spy Phone up close, and we thought it looked best having an agent hold it from the top.

25.name: Festival of Flight
25.label: Festival of Flight
25.flavor_text: During the Festival of Flight, penguins celebrated the many different ways to fly. They used jetpacks, propeller hats, hot air balloons, and more to get the island "off the ground".

26.name: Test Glider
26.label: Test Glider
26.flavor_text: During the Festival of Flight, many penguins used the Test Glider to take to the skies. Aviator goggles were a must have!

27.name: Puffle Paddle
27.label: Puffle Paddle
27.flavor_text: You need fast flippers and sharp reflexes to play Puffle Paddle. Juggle as many puffles as you can, and earn tons of tickets in this popular Fair game.

28.name: Fancy Formal Wear
28.label: Fancy Formal Wear
28.flavor_text: The island's fanciest fashions can be seen on the red carpet during the Penguin Play Awards. All the latest styles can be found at the Gift Shop.

29.name: The Docks
29.label: The Docks
29.flavor_text: Visitors to the Dock will find the Hydro Hopper boat all fueled up and ready to go. Jump in for some extreme tubing, or just chill out and catch some sun.

30.name: Orange Puffle
30.label: Orange Puffle
30.flavor_text: The zaniest of all puffles, these curious creatures were first discovered at the Puffle Party in 2010. Their buckteeth and quirky personalities make them stand out in any crowd.

31.name: Community Tree
31.label: Community Tree
31.flavor_text: The entire community of Club Penguin helped plant this special tree during the Earth Day celebration in 2010. Many believe it will be the tallest tree on the island someday.

32.name: Community Garden
32.label: Community Garden
32.flavor_text: Many penguins have a passion for gardening. So during the Earth Day celebration in 2010, a community garden was planted at the Mine Shack. Now anyone can go there and plant vegetables!

33.name: Island Adventure Party
33.label: Island Adventure Party
33.flavor_text: In June of 2010, penguins were invited to dress up as pirates, captains, and even castaways. Mermaids and sailors in seafaring dresses were also spotted during the celebration.

34.name: Shops in Igloos
34.label: Shops in Igloos
34.flavor_text: In 2010, the Better Igloos catalog began selling clothing racks and displays so penguins could set up their own shops. Now there are many unique and interesting showing up all over the island,

35.name: Seafarer's Gown
35.label: Seafarer's Gown
35.flavor_text: A popular costume during the Island Adventure Party. The Seafarer's Gown and Bonny Curls were perfect for any gal that wanted to sail while looking their best.

36.name: Music Jam Dancers
36.label: Music Jam Dancers
36.flavor_text: Music Jam is about more than just music! The island's annual festival is about finding the best styles and sounds to express yourself, including your best dance moves.

37.name: Music Jam Rock Stage
37.label: Music Jam Rock Stage
37.flavor_text: Rock is a popular style of music during Music Jam, the island's annual music festival. Many penguins enjoy breaking out there electric guitars and rocking out at the Lighthouse.

38.name: Music Jam Pop Stage
38.label: Music Jam Pop Stage
38.flavor_text: Pop concerts are a huge hit with audiences. During the Music Jam festival, the Beach is set up with all the lights and sound systems a pop star needs!

39.name: Underwater Adventure
39.label: Underwater Adventure
39.flavor_text: Daring Daisy and Fearless Fiesel star in this Stage Play. Join them as they journey to discover the hidden underwater city of Penglantis!

40.name: Norman Swarm
40.label: Norman Swarm
40.flavor_text: This Stage play featured Norman, a shrunken penguin who must befriend a swarm of bugs to help him. Together they find a way to return Norman to his normal size.

41.name: Puffle Rescuer
41.label: Puffle Rescuer
41.flavor_text: Puffle rescuers need to have quick reflexes, and nerves of steel. Navigating dangerous ice floes, treacherous caverns and dangerous creatures is all part of the job.

42.name: Everyday Phoning Facility
42.label: Everyday Phoning Facility
42.flavor_text: This is an average Everyday Phoning Facility, over in the Ski Village. There's nothing to see here... unless you happen to receive an invitation to the Elite Penguin Force...

43.name: Jet Packs
43.label: Jet Packs
43.flavor_text: Gary the Gadget Guy, inventor of the jet pack, makes sure there's always enough for everyone. That makes a LOT of jet packs.

44.name: Pumpkin Igloo
44.label: Pumpkin Igloo
44.flavor_text: Nothing says Halloween like pumpkins for your igloo... except make a pumpkin igloo! This special igloo design only appears during Halloween in the Igloo Upgrades catalog.

45.name: Treasure Hunt Adventure
45.label: Treasure Hunt Adventure
45.flavor_text: A great treasure hunt was held during the Island Adventure Party. Penguins had to search for pieces of a lost map, to find where treasure was buried. X marked the spot!

46.name: Destroyed PSA HQ
46.label: Destroyed PSA HQ
46.flavor_text: In May of 2010, PSA agents were called in to stop one of Herbert's plans. Though agents saved everyone from harm, Herbert managed to destroy the PSA's HQ with a popcorn device.

47.name: Captains
47.label: Captains
47.flavor_text: During the Island Adventure Party, a group of classy captains banded together to try and battle the pirates. They did their best to find more treasure, and have more adventures than anyone else.

48.name: April Fools
48.label: April Fools
48.flavor_text: April Fools is a strange but funny celebration in Club Penguin. There's all sorts of weird silliness happening. It's easy to join in,-pull a prank, or tell a crazy joke.

49.name: The Great Snow Maze
49.label: The Great Snow Maze
49.flavor_text: During November of 2009, penguins were invited to solve the Great Snow Maze. Many penguins worked together to reach the end, and were awarded with a Yeti costume.

50.name: Jacques Hammer
50.label: Jacques Hammer
50.flavor_text: This penguin private investigator is one of the stars of the Stage play "Ruby and the Ruby". He's a no-nonsense penguin who doesn't miss a clue, and always finds what he's looking for.

51.name: Throne of April Fools
51.label: Throne of April Fools
51.flavor_text: During the April Fools Party, the entire island goes topsy-turvy. Those who join in the fun may even be crowned the King of April Fools... though kings are crowned every few minutes.

52.name: The Test
52.label: The Test
52.flavor_text: To join the Elite Penguin Force, first you must complete The Test. This Test will challenge all of an agent's skills, including their speed, stealth and how clever they are.

53.name: Cloud Maker 3000
53.label: Cloud Maker 3000
53.flavor_text: During the Festival of Flight, a machine called the Cloud-Maker 3000 could make clouds of different shapes. Anvil clouds turned out to be surprisingly heavy!

54.name: Super Exclusives
54.label: Super Exclusives
54.flavor_text: These ultra-rare items are only available to those who have entered at least 5 codes into the Treasure Book. Codes can be found on games, books and other Club Penguin toys.

55.name: Rockslide at the Mine
55.label: Rockslide at the Mine
55.flavor_text: In January 2010, the whole island was surprised by a rockslide in the Mine. Construction crews quickly cleaned up the mess, and discovered a number of hidden caves.

56.name: Mer-penguins
56.label: Mer-penguins
56.flavor_text: Mer-penguins have shown up in many places. From the Underwater Adventure Stage play, to the Island Adventure Party, mer-penguins are a welcome addition to any celebration.

57.name: Puffer Fish
57.label: Puffer Fish
57.flavor_text: One of the many hazards that Aqua Grabber pilots need to avoid. These puffer fish can inflate to almost a hundred times their normal size, and their spikes can do a lot of damage.

58.name: Garden Hose
58.label: Garden Hose
58.flavor_text: Released during the Earth Day celebration in 2010, this watering pack keeps water from freezing, now penguins can water their gardens no matter how cold it is.

59.name: Fixing the Mine Shack
59.label: Fixing the Mine Shack
59.flavor_text: During the Earth Day celebration, penguins decided it was time to fix up the Mine Shack. So everyone pitched in to help build a large community garden there.

60.name: Puffle Circus
60.label: Puffle Circus
60.flavor_text: Come one, come all, to the great Puffle Circus! Only in town during the Fair, penguins can see puffles of all colors perform amazing acts!

61.name: Puffle Play Sketch
61.label: Puffle Play Sketch
61.flavor_text: This sketch shows a yellow and blue puffle using items from their "super plays". It was used for an Aunt Arctic article, and it inspired the webpage we use for our Puffle Documentary video.

62.name: Dragon Statue
62.label: Dragon Statue
62.flavor_text: During Medieval Party 2010, a new Knight's Quest appeared. This quest brought adventurers into a cave filled with puzzles, and fearsome statues of its owner...

63.name: Popcorn Party
63.label: Popcorn Party
63.flavor_text: An unexpected pile of popcorn appeared at the Ski Village in May 2010, so penguins decided to throw a Popcorn Party. It took two weeks to eat the whole pile!

64.name: White Puffle Room
64.label: White Puffle Room
64.flavor_text: During the island's annual Puffle Party, each puffle color has a room decorated in its honor. When the white puffle was discovered, the Mine was turned into an icy paradise.

65.name: Green Puffle Sketch
65.label: Green Puffle Sketch
65.flavor_text: This sketch shows a small part of the green puffle room from the Puffle Party of 2010. The final picture made the cover of the newspaper!

66.name: Fishbowl Igloo
66.label: Fishbowl Igloo
66.flavor_text: One of the more unusual igloo designs, the Fishbowl Igloo lets you see the world from the eyes of a Fluffy fish. It can be found from time to time in the Better Igloos catalog.

67.name: Ship Battle Adventure
67.label: Ship Battle Adventure
67.flavor_text: The competition between pirates and captains reached epic proportions during the Island Adventure Party. A great battle awaited those who dared to join in!

68.name: Elite Penguin Force
68.label: Elite Penguin Force
68.flavor_text: Secret protectors of Club Penguin, the Elite Penguin Force can tackle any emergency. When the PSA was destroyed by Herbert, the EPF took over all secret agent operations.
