69.name: Rockhopper's Notice Board
69.label: Rockhopper's Notice Board
69.flavor_text: Whenever Rockhopper visits Club Penguin, he writes down all the things he's looking forward to doing. He posts this list on the notice board down in the Migrator's Hold.

70.name: Squid Lid
70.label: Squid Lid
70.flavor_text: This weirdly shaped but strangely comfortable hat was brought by Rockhopper in June of 2010. Penguins has voted it their favorite out of three possible hats, including a bucket and an old boot!

71.name: Hidden Lake
71.label: Hidden Lake
71.flavor_text: Deep underground is a secret cave filled with water, called the Hidden Lake. To find it, you'll need to journey into the caves beyond the mine, or find the other hidden entrance...

72.name: Orange Puffle Wagon
72.label: Orange Puffle Wagon
72.description: When this is played, Water cards become Fire for this round.
72.flavor_text: When an orange puffle is completely fed and happy, watch out! They tend to unexpectedly take out a mega monster-truck and hit the gas!

73.name: Haunted House
73.label: Haunted House
73.description: When this is scored, Snow cannot be played next round.
73.flavor_text: One dark  Halloween night in 2009, a haunted house appeared at the Mine Shack. This menacing mansion had moving statues, paintings that watched you, and puffle pranksters!

74.name: Fire Dragon
74.label: Fire Dragon
74.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Red card.
74.flavor_text: Warriors and princesses alike had to battle this mechanical menace at the end of the  Knight's Quest at the Medieval Party. Only by working together could they extinguish his flame and claim the treasure!

75.name: Puffle Rescue: Underground
75.label: Puffle Rescue: Underground
75.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Orange card.
75.flavor_text: Suit up and prepare to go underground! Pink puffles have been lost in the caves below Club Penguin. Jump mine carts, snow cannons, and blasts of steam to succeed.

76.name: Double Necked Guitar
76.label: Double Necked Guitar
76.description: When this is scored, Water cannot be played next round.
76.flavor_text: This powerful instrument first appeared during Music Jam in 2010. It was released by surprise halfway through the festival, so penguins had one more chance to rock out.

77.name: Puffle Rescue: Ice Floes
77.label: Puffle Rescue: Ice Floes
77.description: When this is played, Fire cards become Snowball for this round.
77.flavor_text: Blue puffles need your help! Many are trapped on dangerous ice floes, surrounded by sharks! Jump between chunks of ice, and watch out for cracks to save them.

78.name: Spy Phone
78.label: Spy Phone
78.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Purple card.
78.flavor_text: This ultimate spy gadget has everything an Elite Agent needs. It can receive orders, teleport agents to any location, and even help complete special tasks.

79.name: Dance Contest
79.label: Dance Contest
79.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Water card.
79.flavor_text: Over at the Night Club, DJ Cadence keeps the Dance Contest going with seriously epic music. Penguins looking to show off their moves can dance solo, or compete with their friends.

80.name: Crab Costume
80.label: Crab Costume
80.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Blue card.
80.flavor_text: This rare costume is available in the Treasure Book catalog. However, Elite Agents on the Herbert's Revenge case will also receive one for a  special assignment...

81.name: Puffle Washer
81.label: Puffle Washer
81.description: When this is scored, Fire cannot be played next round.
81.flavor_text: This high-powered washer will scrub away any mess within just a few seconds. Your puffles will come out fresh and clean every time. Available only in the Pet Shop's Furniture catalog!

82.name: Green Jackhammer
82.label: Green Jackhammer
82.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Fire card.
82.flavor_text: This unique tool showed up during the Earth Day celebration. Penguins voted it their favorite out of three choices. It can grow tree saplings instantly!

83.name: The Veggie Villain
83.label: The Veggie Villain
83.description: When this is played, Snowball cards become Water for this round.
83.flavor_text: To stop the PSA, Herbert needed to break into its computer systems. When a secret agent stopped the attack, Herbert was able to teleport his popcorn device into the HQ and destroy it!

84.name: Island Lifter 3000
84.label: Island Lifter 3000
84.description: When this is played, Water cards become Fire for this round.
84.flavor_text: Invented by Gary the Gadget Guy, this powerful device lifted the entire island of Club Penguin into the sky for the Festival of Flight!

85.name: Flare
85.label: Flare
85.description: When this is scored, Snow cannot be played next round.
85.flavor_text: One of the Elite Puffles from the Elite Penguin Force. Flare can blow blue fire, which can weld nearly anything together. Agents on the Herbert's Revenge case can summon Flare anytime.

86.name: Popcorn Device
86.label: Popcorn Device
86.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Red card.
86.flavor_text: To destroy the PSA, Herbert P. Bear needed a powerful device. In May of 2010, he built that device–a souped-up popcorn popper!

87.name: Field-Ops
87.label: Field-Ops
87.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Orange card.
87.flavor_text: Elite Agents receive orders every week for important tasks or critical situations. Agents can report for duty by accessing the Field-Ops computer in the Command Room.

88.name: Recipe for Disaster
88.label: Recipe for Disaster
88.description: When this is scored, Water cannot be played next round.
88.flavor_text: When Herbert successfully destroyed the PSA, he celebrated by making all kinds of treats. His gloating would not last long though, as the Elite Penguin Force was soon on his case.

89.name: Elite Agent
89.label: Elite Agent
89.description: When this is played, Fire cards become Snowball for this round.
89.flavor_text: Elite Agents must learn a number of highly specialized skills to complete their tasks. Re-wiring circuits, repowering electronics, and bypassing security systems are just some of the basics!

90.name: Aunt Arctic Sketch
90.label: Aunt Arctic Sketch
90.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's purple card.
90.flavor_text: This Aunt Arctic sketch is fairly recent, and shows her not-often-seen igloo. Because penguins have seen her so often, we always try to draw her in new and interesting poses.

91.name: Yeti Cave
91.label: Yeti Cave
91.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Water card.
91.flavor_text: This peculiar place was discovered at the end of the Great Snow Maze in November 2009. A room fit for any Yeti!

92.name: Shocktopus
92.label: Shocktopus
92.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Blue card.
92.flavor_text: Rescuers must face these high-voltage sea creatures during underwater levels in Puffle Rescue. They're rather shocking to see, and even more so to touch. Avoid at all costs!

93.name: Puffle Rescue: Underwater
93.label: Puffle Rescue: Underwater
93.description: When this is scored, Fire cannot be played next round.
93.flavor_text: Calling all rescuers: Black puffles are trapped underwater! Suit up and dive in! More than anything, make sure not to sink too far into the deep...

94.name: Hidden Lake Lock
94.label: Hidden Lake Lock
94.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Fire card.
94.flavor_text: When the Hidden Lake was discovered, explorers also found a mysterious locked door... Underwater. The key was later discovered by Puffle Rescuers, who followed a strange shadow...

95.name: Knight's Quest
95.label: Knight's Quest
95.description: When this is played, Snowball cards become Water for this round.
95.flavor_text: The Knight's Quest is an adventure fit for any knight... or princess! Solve all the puzzles to discover untold treasures during the Medieval Party!

111.name: WATER SENSEI
111.label: WATER SENSEI
111.flavor_text: Masters of Card-Jitsu will face a wave of new challenges in the Water Dojo. Train to beat your opponents and defeat Sensei. Then you'll reach your destiny, and become a Water Ninja.

112.name: WATER NINJA
112.label: WATER NINJA
112.flavor_text: A Ninja mastering the element of water will earn five powerful items - the Waved Sandals, the Waterfall Coat, the Torrent Mask, the Helmet of Oceans and the Water Gem.

113.name: WATER VIDEO SKETCH
113.label: WATER VIDEO SKETCH
113.flavor_text: Here's a color sketch from the Card-Jitsu Water video we started back in August 2010. It was fun to imagine the rain. You can see the very top of the Dojo in the puddle-which we had never drawn before!

1.name: Spooky Igloo Contest
1.label: Spooky Igloo Contest
1.flavor_text: October 2010 saw a return of the spooky igloo contest. Penguins who picked up costumes and furniture items can keep the spine-chilling style all year 'round.

2.name: Halloween Countdown!
2.label: Halloween Countdown!
2.flavor_text: We prepared for Halloween 2010 with a chilling countdown and creepy costumes. Then, we searched for candy in the Swamp Quest.

3.name: Stormy Skies
3.label: Stormy Skies
3.flavor_text: Stormy skies rolled over the island and cast shadows over October 2010's Halloween festivities. In November the dark clouds burst with the first ever rain in Club Penguin.

4.name: 5th Anniversary Party
4.label: 5th Anniversary Party
4.flavor_text: October 24th 2010 was the 5th Anniversary Party in Club Penguin. Penguins earned a Celebration Stamp for blowing out the candles on the massive cake in the Coffee Shop.

5.name: 5th Anniversary Cake
5.label: 5th Anniversary Cake
5.flavor_text: Club Penguin turned five at the October 24th Anniversary Party! Penguins found a party hat and orange puffles were excited to share the giant Anniversary cake.

6.name: 5th Anniversary Yearbook
6.label: 5th Anniversary Yearbook
6.flavor_text: During the Anniversary Party of 2010, we celebrated the past year with a brand new Yearbook and original penguin artwork in the Book Room.

7.name: Snowball Fight!
7.label: Snowball Fight!
7.flavor_text: Snowball: a ball of snow pressed together to throw. Or... an excuse to get your snow gear on and head to the Snow Forts for a frozen fight!

8.name: Find Four
8.label: Find Four
8.flavor_text: Challenge your buddy to a game of Find Four in the Ski Lodge. While you're there, you may also see a giant mullet, a moose head and Fred the Cuckoo clock bird.

9.name: Cozy Ski Lodge
9.label: Cozy Ski Lodge
9.flavor_text: After playing in the snow or at the Ice Rink with your white puffle, chill together by the fire at the Ski Lodge.

10.name: Holiday Decorations!
10.label: Holiday Decorations!
10.flavor_text: The Holiday Party 2010 was full of festive costumes and igloo items. In typical penguin fashion, we were thrilled to decorate our igloos... and ourselves.

11.name: Book Room Adventures
11.label: Book Room Adventures
11.flavor_text: The Book Room above the Coffee Shop is filled with Yearbook memories and tall tales, too! You might even discover a few secrets inside some of the pages...

12.name: Halloween Forest
12.label: Halloween Forest
12.flavor_text: After putting on their creepy costumes in the October Penguin Style, Frankenpenguins and other monsters braved their way through the Forest to find the Haunted House.

13.name: Brown Puffle Rocket
13.label: Brown Puffle Rocket
13.flavor_text: The brown puffle pet is super smart, inventive, and wears safety goggles. It's a good thing because its rocket is a bit unpredictable.

14.name: Fun at the Fair!
14.label: Fun at the Fair!
14.flavor_text: At The Fair in September 2010, we played games, earned tickets and won fabulous prizes! Puffles and penguins performed magic tricks at stages Rockhopper brought.

15.name: Ski Hill Challenge
15.label: Ski Hill Challenge
15.flavor_text: Sledding is the perfect way to spend time with your buddies. Just head to top of the Ski Hill, and check out the Toboggan or Racing Sleds in the Game Upgrades catalog.

16.name: Holiday Party Skating
16.label: Holiday Party Skating
16.flavor_text: During the Holiday Party 2010, penguins got their skates from the Snow and Sports catalog and spent time with their buddies at the Ice Rink.

17.name: Treasure!
17.label: Treasure!
17.flavor_text: When the Migrator docks at the Beach, you can play Rockhopper's special Treasure Hunt game. Find it, and maybe find a few really rare gems, in the Captain's Quarters.

18.name: Lumberjack Look
18.label: Lumberjack Look
18.flavor_text: The Lumberjack Look outfit from the January Penguin Style catalog got us in the spirit of adventure! We needed it to complete the Wilderness Expedition 2011.

19.name: Pink Sparkle Snowshoes
19.label: Pink Sparkle Snowshoes
19.flavor_text: In January 2011 the Pink Sparkly Snowshoes hit Penguin Style just in time for the Wilderness Expedition. Who says exploration gear can't be stylish?

20.name: Holiday Tree 2010
20.label: Holiday Tree 2010
20.flavor_text: The Holiday Party 2010 was full of surprises. Penguins discovered a mysterious room called "???". There, they found the biggest and brightest tree ever seen in Club Penguin.

21.name: Fill the Lighthouse!
21.label: Fill the Lighthouse!
21.flavor_text: During Coins For Change 2010, Rockhopper challenged everyone to "Fill the Lighthouse!" Penguins gave over 12 billion Club Penguin coins that helped real kids around the world.

22.name: Wilderness Machine
22.label: Wilderness Machine
22.flavor_text: Penguin explorers had to make this elevator machine work during the Wilderness Expedition in January 2011. Experts presume the brown puffle invented it.

23.name: Expedition Boat
23.label: Expedition Boat
23.flavor_text: Building the boat during the Wilderness Expedition in January 2011 was a challenge. But getting to adopt a brown puffle across the bay was worth it.

24.name: Wilderness Expedition Cave
24.label: Wilderness Expedition Cave
24.flavor_text: During the Wilderness Expedition in January 2011, we completed several challenges, including a maze and a boat ride across the bay. Then we discovered the brown puffle!

25.name: Water Party Prep
25.label: Water Party Prep
25.flavor_text: In November 2010, even before the rain clouds flooded the island, penguins at work were finding leaks and looking for messes to mop.

26.name: Water Dance
26.label: Water Dance
26.flavor_text: Brave ninjas can battle opponents at the Waterfall behind the Dojo and earn Water Suits. Press 'D' when you wear only your suit and demonstrate your power to control water.

27.name: Stamp Collectors
27.label: Stamp Collectors
27.flavor_text: Your Stamp Books help you track the things you've done on the island. And while you can't really turn yourself into one, you CAN customize yours!

28.name: Explore the Wilderness
28.label: Explore the Wilderness
28.flavor_text: We geared up in expedition gear from Penguin Style and then found adventures during the Wilderness Expedition in January 2011. In the end, we discovered the brown puffle!

29.name: Coins for Change 2010!
29.label: Coins for Change 2010!
29.flavor_text: Protecting the Earth, Building Safe places and Providing Medical Help are things we can rally around! During Coins For Change 2010, penguins gave over 12 billion Club Penguin coins. Yes, BILLION!

30.name: Penguin Colors
30.label: Penguin Colors
30.flavor_text: Penguins can choose their color from the Penguin Style catalog! In 2006 players voted to get Lime Green added, and in 2009 players chose Aqua over lavender and maroon.

31.name: Fairy Fables
31.label: Fairy Fables
31.flavor_text: September 2010 saw a return of the popular Fairy Fables play at the Stage. Penguins interested in acting auditioned for the roles of characters like Twee and the Big Bad Wool.

32.name: Penguins That Time Forgot
32.label: Penguins That Time Forgot
32.flavor_text: "Penguins That Time Forgot" hit the Stage again in January 2011. Actors clamored to the Costume Trunk to get their Time-Traveler's hats, Tiki Masks and their Big Brows.

33.name: EPF Sketch
33.label: EPF Sketch
33.flavor_text: This sketch was created when the Elite Penguin Force agents started doing Field Ops in June 2010. Secret agents work together to get things done.

34.name: Cove Stories
34.label: Cove Stories
34.flavor_text: The Cove is a place we go to tell stories and play the Catchin' Waves game. If you've taken on the waves there, you've probably got some extreme tales to tell.

35.name: Orange Circus Puffle
35.label: Orange Circus Puffle
35.flavor_text: During the Fair in September 2010, the orange puffle joined the circus and zoomed around the tent it its vehicle. The finale was eating the car.

36.name: Hydro Hopper
36.label: Hydro Hopper
36.flavor_text: The first ever game in Club Penguin, Hydro Hopper was formerly known as Ballistic Biscuit. Head to the Dock to grab your inner tube and challenge the waters.

37.name: Igloo Party!
37.label: Igloo Party!
37.flavor_text: To change up your igloo, choose a new design, get some furniture items, and decorate. Then throw a party and invite your friends.

38.name: Life Underwater
38.label: Life Underwater
38.flavor_text: During Underwater Adventure, brave penguin divers go on a journey. Along the way they discover a grumpy fish who tells them about the lost city of Penglantis.

39.name: Herbert's Monologue
39.label: Herbert's Monologue
39.flavor_text: Herbert made his first appearance in the PSA mission "Questions for a Crab". After capturing a Secret Agent, he explained his life story and dastardly plans. His flow chart contained over 30 hand drawn pages.

40.name: Enemy Bots
40.label: Enemy Bots
40.flavor_text: Agents must protect against many different kinds of enemies in the game System Defender. Each has its own strengths and weaknesses. Find out more in G's tutorial in the Command Room.

41.name: Paint By Letters
41.label: Paint By Letters
41.flavor_text: In the Book Room, find these special books to hone your keyboard skills, shape your own story, and even find a few secrets!

42.name: Secret Agent
42.label: Secret Agent
42.flavor_text: Classified: To become an Elite Agent, respond to an invitation from another agent. Then head to the Everyday Phoning Facility to take the training test. Your duty? Protect the island.

43.name: Fireworks
43.label: Fireworks
43.flavor_text: Fireworks filled the sky during 2010's New Year's celebrations. This particular image appeared on the front page of the December 21, 2010 edition of the Club Penguin Times.

44.name: EPF Tech Agent
44.label: EPF Tech Agent
44.flavor_text: The brains of the Elite Penguin Force, the Tech Class, are technology experts. Dressed as civilians, they shut down enemy defenses via their computers.

45.name: Popcorn Explosion
45.label: Popcorn Explosion
45.flavor_text: In May 2010, Herbert's popcorn explosion meant we had to replace the Sport Shop with the Everyday Phoning Facility. Nothing unusual ever happens there...

46.name: Walk Your Puffle
46.label: Walk Your Puffle
46.flavor_text: Black puffles often look grumpy. But don't let their exterior fool you. They're excellent pets who excel with skateboards... They'll even help you in the Cart Surfer game.

47.name: Sumo Smash
47.label: Sumo Smash
47.flavor_text: Smashing your opponents off the 'berg will get you one step closer to conquering the island. Sumo Smash is a game made especially for Club Penguin's Game Day for Wii.

48.name: inventive Brown Puffle
48.label: inventive Brown Puffle
48.flavor_text: Very inventive, your brown puffle will surprise you with its elaborate creations. Adopt this machine-making puffle from the Pet Shop!

49.name: Holiday Party Tree
49.label: Holiday Party Tree
49.flavor_text: Reindeer, elves and puffles were seen gathering around the massive tree during the December 2010 Holiday Party. We decorated it ourselves!

50.name: EPF Enemies
50.label: EPF Enemies
50.flavor_text: These three Boss Bugs were sketched in the summer of 2010. The artists wanted them to look as if they could harm a computer system. Elite Agents can attack these Club Penguin enemies in System Defense in the Command Room.

51.name: Tall Tree Maze
51.label: Tall Tree Maze
51.flavor_text: Adventurous penguins can puffles made their way through the Tall Trees to find the new brown puffle during the Wilderness Expedition in January 2011.

52.name: Sled 'n Slide
52.label: Sled 'n Slide
52.flavor_text: Teamwork is key when you're flying down the hill on a sled with your friends in Sled 'n Slide game for Wii... Get a good time and your team will be closer to conquering Club Penguin Island!

53.name: Underwater at the Stage
53.label: Underwater at the Stage
53.flavor_text: For a long time, players asked for a stage set under the water. So the Club Penguin team made one! In Underwater Adventure, you can get the costumes of Toby the Lobster, a Mermaid, or a Merman.

54.name: Wilderness Expedition Travel
54.label: Wilderness Expedition Travel
54.flavor_text: During the Wilderness Expedition, we had to take a boat to get across the bay. But first we had to build it and put our lifejackets on!

55.name: Catch the Mullet!
55.label: Catch the Mullet!
55.flavor_text: From the Lodge, you can get to the Ice Fishing game and catch fish. Shhhh... To get the giant mullet use a smaller fish as bait!

56.name: Great Puffle Circus
56.label: Great Puffle Circus
56.flavor_text: "Step right up to the most daring, extravagant, ama-a-a-a-zing puffle circus!" Talented puffles performed and Ringmasters directed the shows during The Fair 2010.

57.name: Intense Black Puffle
57.label: Intense Black Puffle
57.flavor_text: It's intense and it has some incredible skate tricks, too. If you want some Cart Surfer help, or just a really cool pet, adopt a black puffle from the Pet Shop.

58.name: Brown Puffle Storyboard
58.label: Brown Puffle Storyboard
58.flavor_text: Club Penguin artists had a lot of fun sketching how the brown puffle might play. The scientific pet was discovered during the Wilderness Expedition in January 2011.

59.name: Java Jump
59.label: Java Jump
59.flavor_text: Race your opponents to the finish line! The Java Jump game in Club Penguin's Game Day for Wii will have you jumping... unless you pick up a heavy anvil along the way.

60.name: Wii Game Day "Goal!"
60.label: Wii Game Day "Goal!"
60.flavor_text: You've picked your team... your skates are laced tight. Now guard your net and shoot pucks for the win! Goal!

61.name: Epic White Puffle
61.label: Epic White Puffle
61.flavor_text: First spotted in the Dojo, the shy, snow-loving white puffle holds extraordinary power. Adopt one from the Club Penguin Pet Shop.

62.name: Awesome Blue Puffle
62.label: Awesome Blue Puffle
62.flavor_text: Loyalty is what blue puffles are all about. If you're looking to expand your team with an all-star pet, adopt one in the Pet Shop.

63.name: "Feed a Puffle"
63.label: "Feed a Puffle"
63.flavor_text: All the puffles are hungry in the Club Penguin Wii "Feed A Puffle" Game. But try extra hard to feed a white one – you can get a Stamp in Club Penguin when you feed one.

64.name: Ninja Battle
64.label: Ninja Battle
64.flavor_text: Ninjas compete fiercely in the Dojo to improve their Card-Jitsu skills. After earning their Ninja Mask, many continue to battle to keep their senses sharp. New Power Cards can surprise even the most skilled opponents.

65.name: The Mystery of Sensei
65.label: The Mystery of Sensei
65.flavor_text: Sensei's past is shrouded in mystery. He is the first master of Card-Jitsu, but little else is known about him. He will, however gladly train any student interested in the ways of the ninja. Seek him in the Dojo for training.

66.name: Master the Elements
66.label: Master the Elements
66.flavor_text: Even after you've earned their Ninja Mask, your ninja's training has only begun. The next step of your journey is to master the elements. Search the Ninja Hideout for paths to new Dojos... and new challenges.

67.name: Brown Puffle
67.label: Brown Puffle
67.flavor_text: The Brown Puffle was first discovered in January 2011. Explorers crossed a hidden bay into the wilds of Club Penguin, and found them in a cave. Many puffles even followed the explorers back. Adopt one today the Pet Shop.

68.name: Fire Wave
68.label: Fire Wave
68.flavor_text: Fire Ninjas who wear all the parts of their Fire Suit can control fire by pressing 'D' on their keyboard. Many used this power to help melt snow and pump water during the Water Dojo construction in November 2010.

69.name: Black Puffles in Cart Surfer
69.label: Black Puffles in Cart Surfer
69.flavor_text: In October 2010, black puffles were found exploring the Mine. It was quickly discovered that they were interested in Cart Surfing. To take your black puffle along, just walk to the Mine and start a game.

70.name: Mountain Expedition
70.label: Mountain Expedition
70.flavor_text: During August 2010, a Mountain Expedition was organized to climb to the top of Toughest Mountain. Many teams of penguins suited up with new climbing gear, and worked together to face the mountain.

71.name: Climbing the Mountain
71.label: Climbing the Mountain
71.flavor_text: Climbers faced many obstacles during the Mountain Expedition in August 2010. Icy caverns and harsh weather made the climb very tiring. Many stopped to rest at base camp before climbing to the summit.

72.name: Top of Toughest Mountain
72.label: Top of Toughest Mountain
72.flavor_text: The final challenge for climbers during the Mountain Expedition in August 2010 was to reach the top. Many who did took a picture to celebrate, which could then be used as a player card background!

73.name: Cart Surfer Stamps
73.label: Cart Surfer Stamps
73.flavor_text: To earn all the Stamps in Cart Surfer, you'll need practice... and a little help. For some of the challenges, surfers will need to bring a black puffle with them. You can adopt one of these from the Pet Shop.

74.name: Stamp Book
74.label: Stamp Book
74.flavor_text: Stamps Books tell YOUR story. Inside you'll find all the pins you've found, the games you've mastered, and the medals you've earned. Customize yours to show others what you like... and what you can do!

75.name: Stormy Sky
75.label: Stormy Sky
75.flavor_text: Dark and stormy skies continued to cover the island after the 2010 Halloween Party was over. No one could explain the mysterious weather at first – even Gary the Gadget Guy was baffled.

76.name: Water Wave Sketches
76.label: Water Wave Sketches
76.flavor_text: What do Water Ninjas look like when they're controlling water? That's the question we asked while working on these sketches. We tried lots of different designs, making the water look 'smooth' and 'froamy', until we found the way we liked best.

77.name: Storm Baffles Gary
77.label: Storm Baffles Gary
77.flavor_text: When the Halloween Storm arrived in October 2010, Gary the Gadget Guy was puzzled. "I had never experienced a storm like it before," he said. "I watched it closely through the binoculars at the Cove. It was very intriguing."

78.name: Water Ninja
78.label: Water Ninja
78.flavor_text: Card-Jitsu Water is a fast paced battle. It takes quick thinking and fast flippers to master. Those who do will earn their Water Suit, a Water Gem, and the right to call themselves a Water Ninja.

79.name: The First Rainstorm
79.label: The First Rainstorm
79.flavor_text: In November 2010, it rained for the first time in Club Penguin history. For days the downpour soaked the island. Weather experts were baffled, and penguins everywhere were spotted with umbrellas and rain gear.

80.name: Ninja Face-off
80.label: Ninja Face-off
80.flavor_text: Ninjas must give their all facing one another in battle. Though matches are fierce, Sensei teaches that competition is the best way to improve your skill. Win or lose, ninjas always remain loyal allies, so remember to tell your opponent "good game!"

81.name: Earning the Water Suit
81.label: Earning the Water Suit
81.flavor_text: Each part of the Water Ninja Suit is a symbol of skill. They must be earned in order – first the Water Sandals, then the Waterfall Coat and the Torrent Mask. Once you earn the Helmet of Oceans, you're ready to face Sensei.

82.name: Water Pumping Gadget
82.label: Water Pumping Gadget
82.flavor_text: A rainstorm drenched the island in November 2010. At Sensei's request, workers set up machines to pump rainwater up to the Dojo. The machines ran on snowballs and Fire Ninja flames!

83.name: Preparing the Water Dojo
83.label: Preparing the Water Dojo
83.flavor_text: During November 2010, everyone helped pump rainwater up to the Dojo. This water was needed to build a new Dojo for Water Ninja training. For a week, much of the island was covered in pipes and water tanks.

84.name: Gate to the Water Dojo
84.label: Gate to the Water Dojo
84.flavor_text: The path to the Water Dojo begins in the Ninja Hideout. Once you have an Amulet, touch the stone tablet marked with a sater[4] symbol. A gate will appear and open. Enter it, if you are prepared...

85.name: Water Suit
85.label: Water Suit
85.flavor_text: When a ninja wears all the parts of the Water Suit, they will have the power to control water. Wearing only the suit, press 'D', and a wave of water will surge around you.

86.name: Sign From The Elements
86.label: Sign From The Elements
86.flavor_text: The rainstorm in November 2010 was a sign that ninjas were ready to master the element of water. Sensei soon announced the construction of the Water Dojo. It opened on November 25... and Card-Jitsu Water training began.

87.name: Sensei - Master of Water
87.label: Sensei - Master of Water
87.flavor_text: During construction of the Water Dojo in November 2010, Sensei appeared in the Ninja Hideout. Dressed in his Water Robe, he helped ninjas prepare... and showed them what the power of a Water Ninja could do.

88.name: Water Ninja Poster Sketch
88.label: Water Ninja Poster Sketch
88.flavor_text: This rough sketch was an idea for a poster, showing all the different parts of the new Card-Jitsu Water game. We wanted to make it feel like the beginning of an ancient legend or story. That's why Sensei is so big – he's not a giant, it's just for style!

89.name: Water Ninja Sketch
89.label: Water Ninja Sketch
89.flavor_text: This sketch of a Water Ninja was created for a membership card design. We wanted to show how it feels to become a Water Ninja – to have such awesome power and skill. That's why we left off his mask – we wanted to see his expression!

90.name: Water Beats Fire Sketch
90.label: Water Beats Fire Sketch
90.flavor_text: When we were designing what Water Ninjas looked like, it helped to sketch them in different battle poses. We really like this early drawing we found in an artist's sketch book.

91.name: Blast
91.label: Blast
91.flavor_text: "Dude. Soooo loving the shades. They make me even stronger and more silent. Maybe later we can hang out and I'll eat a Puffle O to entertain 'ya."

92.name: Flare
92.label: Flare
92.flavor_text: "You think this is fast? You should see how I move when I get shot from a cannon! It's a riot! And I think, actually, it increases happiness."

93.name: Chirp
93.label: Chirp
93.flavor_text: "Paints, creativity, and music," Chirp replies with whimsy. "Mix those up with some imagination and you got a masterpiece, my friends, a masterpiece!"

94.name: Pop
94.label: Pop
94.flavor_text: "I love bubbles! They're beautiful to blow. Bouncy. Breathtaking. Transparent perfection, I say!"

95.name: Loop
95.label: Loop
95.flavor_text: When a ninja wears all the parts of the Water Suit, they will have the power to control weather. Wearing only the suit, press 'D', and a wave of water will surge around you.[10]

96.name: Flit
96.label: Flit
96.flavor_text: "Um, nope! Can't touch this propeller hat," Flit laughs loudly. "It takes tons of practice... Even I need it! Recall Christmas 2008 when I got stuck sideways in a tree?!"

97.name: Bouncer
97.label: Bouncer
97.flavor_text: "It's so cool to bounce around like my ball," he declares. "By the way... it rolled under a ginormous pile of snow and though I'm small, round, and can roll, I'm a bit too puffy. Can you help?"

98.name: Niblet
98.label: Niblet
98.flavor_text: "From this snowman emerges the almighty Niblet, the might green puffle! He's been trying to become a white puffle by hiding in the snow."

99.name: Puffles on the Loose
99.label: Puffles on the Loose
99.flavor_text: Sometimes rounding up puffles feels a little like chasing a rainbow. Lots of colors, but the closer you get the farther away it seems.

100.name: Golden puffle
100.label: Golden puffle
100.flavor_text: Such a popular myth, they made a Stage play about it. Does this puffle really live under the 'berg?

101.name: Meteor puffle
101.label: Meteor puffle
101.flavor_text: Swoosh, the mysterious meteor puffle flies through the air with the greatest of ease...

102.name: Rainbow puffle
102.label: Rainbow puffle
102.flavor_text: A multi-colored legend, or just a creative little yellow puffle who has been playing with paint?

103.name: Abominable snow puffle
103.label: Abominable snow puffle
103.flavor_text: "I'm telling ya, it was huge! Twice the size of a penguin and it had claws like a crab. I was shaking in my snow boots!"

104.name: Black Puffle
104.label: Black Puffle
104.flavor_text: "Turbo is my black puffle. It rolls its eyes a lot," replies the penguin as he feeds his pet a flipper full of Puffle O's. "It really gets fired up when I take it out for a walk."

105.name: Blue Puffle
105.label: Blue Puffle
105.flavor_text: "As an employee, I value the blue puffles," replies the staff member. "They are loyal, easy to take care of, and fun to play ball with. You can't go wrong with a blue puffle."

106.name: Pink Puffle
106.label: Pink Puffle
106.flavor_text: "This is my pink puffle, Cutie! I named it that because I think its eyes are sooo adorable," continues the ballet dancer. "Plus it matches my outfit!"

107.name: Green Puffle
107.label: Green Puffle
107.flavor_text: "My puffle Greenie is the silliest puffle I've ever met, which is why we get along so well," she giggles. "I love it when it plays on its unicycle – it's so funny!"

108.name: Purple Puffle
108.label: Purple Puffle
108.flavor_text: "Oh! Look at that one over there blowing bubbles! That one is sooo cute – it should be my pet," she exclaims. "I'll make it Princess Purple because I love princesses and purple!"

109.name: Red Puffle
109.label: Red Puffle
109.flavor_text: "This is my sidekick on my adventures. I named it Fireball because it's so fast when it goes flying out of its cannon like whooooosh! Look, it's going again!"

110.name: Yellow Puffle
110.label: Yellow Puffle
110.flavor_text: "I knew I wanted a yellow puffle from the moment I saw it in the Forest at Halloween," she replies. "My puffle Lemon likes to paint just like I do."

111.name: Master the Elements
111.label: Master the Elements
111.flavor_text: The opening of the Water Dojo is November 2010 meant a celebration of all elemental skills in Club Penguin. Puffles like the elements, too.

112.name: Fairy Fables Stage
112.label: Fairy Fables Stage
112.flavor_text: Fairy Fables is the tale of Prince Redwood who rides through the forest to take croissants to a princess. Check the Stage for a trunk full of costumes and acting opportunities.

113.name: Creative Puffles
113.label: Creative Puffles
113.flavor_text: First discovered in the Forest in 2007, yellow puffles are artistic pets. Adopt one from the Pet Shop and take it into your igloo. Then watch it get creative!

114.name: Goofy Green Puffle
114.label: Goofy Green Puffle
114.flavor_text: The green puffle's a great pal for getting silly. Adopt one at the Pet Shop and try taking it into the Jetpack Adventure game at the Beacon.

115.name: EPF Test Room Sketch
115.label: EPF Test Room Sketch
115.flavor_text: It takes a long time to plan new rooms. Artists sketched the Elite Agent training and testing room in January 2010, way before the Everyday Phoning Facility opened for Elite Agents at the end of May 2010.

116.name: Snowball Battle
116.label: Snowball Battle
116.flavor_text: In Club Penguin Game Day for Wii, winning snowball battles take precision. But it also helps if you know a secret... find the white puffle for some extra snowball action!

117.name: Fabulous Purple Puffle
117.label: Fabulous Purple Puffle
117.flavor_text: It's particular – except when it's on the dance floor. Then it'll show you some great moves. Adopt one from the Pet Shop and then take it to the Dance Contest game to help you.

118.name: Water Party Sketch
118.label: Water Party Sketch
118.flavor_text: This early sketch of the Water Dojo had a few more "polished" elements than it does now. We wanted the area to be quite rough and even a bit perilous to reflect the challenge of the water game.

119.name: Zany Orange Puffle
119.label: Zany Orange Puffle
119.flavor_text: Known for its willingness to chomp on everything, the orange puffle is a wacky pet. Adopt yours at the Club Penguin Pet Shop – and keep an eye on your pizza.

120.name: Sporty Pink Puffle
120.label: Sporty Pink Puffle
120.flavor_text: Pink puffles are sporty creatures – they also like water. Adopt a pink puffle at the Pet Shop and take it into the Aqua Grabber game to help you!

121.name: Puffle Round Up
121.label: Puffle Round Up
121.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Water card.
121.flavor_text: "Okay, I just need to catch a few more for the Pet Shop. Easy now... steady... steady..." says the penguin, thinking out loud. "It takes real concentration to do this!"

122.name: Fire Ninja Force
122.label: Fire Ninja Force
122.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Orange card.
122.flavor_text: In November 2010, Fire Ninjas gathered and used their powers to help get the water flowing to the new Water Dojo. To become a ninja, head to the Dojo and play Card-Jitsu.

123.name: Halloween Swamp
123.label: Halloween Swamp
123.description: When this is scored, Water cannot be played next round.
123.flavor_text: In the  October 2010 Halloween Party, we waddled through mazes. To open the doors into the Dark Chamber, we had to mimic the creepy organ music.

124.name: Prepare for Pumpkins
124.label: Prepare for Pumpkins
124.description: When this is played, Snowball cards become Water for this round
124.flavor_text: Getting a giant pumpkin to the lighthouse was just one part of the 2010 Halloween Party. Penguins got their costumes ready from the October edition of Penguin Style.

125.name: Finding Rockhopper
125.label: Finding Rockhopper
125.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Purple card.
125.flavor_text: One of the Captain's favorite snacks is surprising... stinky cheese! Even without cheese, you may find Rockhopper on his Migrator ship, when it docks in Club Penguin.

126.name: Giant Pearl
126.label: Giant Pearl
126.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Blue card.
126.flavor_text: There are many ways to earn coins in Club Penguin. But the clam that holds the giant pearl in Aqua Grabber might be the sparkliest way of all. Tip: Don't wake up the clam!

127.name: Water Stamps
127.label: Water Stamps
127.description: When this is scored, Fire cannot be played next round.
127.flavor_text: Ninjas who play Card-Jitsu Water can earn stamps that will show off their ninja skills. Go to the Dojo and challenge your opponents to race towards the gong at the Waterfall.

128.name: Puffle Rescue
128.label: Puffle Rescue
128.description: When this is played, Snowball cards become Water for this round.
128.flavor_text: From the Mine, you can take on the task of rescuing puffles in peril when you play Puffle Rescue. And as you navigate the waters, never forget that creatures like squid and sharks are hot on your flippers.

129.name: Fire Dojo Challenge
129.label: Fire Dojo Challenge
129.description: When this is played, Water cards become Fire for this round.
129.flavor_text: Hone your battle skills by challenging ninja opponents at the Fire Dojo. You'll need patience, practice, power. Also, to master this element and become a Fire Ninja, some hot sauce is recommended.

130.name: System Defender
130.label: System Defender
130.description: When this is scored, Snow cannot be played next round.
130.flavor_text: On January 13, 2011, the EPF was attacked by enemy bugs. Agents repelled the attack with a new program called System Defender. Now any agent can train in this game at the Command Room.

131.name: Adventurous Red Puffle
131.label: Adventurous Red Puffle
131.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Red card.
131.flavor_text: Originally brought to Club Penguin from Rockhopper Island, adventurous red puffles love cannons. You can adopt a red puffle from the Pet Shop.

132.name: G and the Machine
132.label: G and the Machine
132.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Orange card.
132.flavor_text: "It's incredibly complex. A machine made from all sorts of things around the island." During the Wilderness Expedition of January 2011, we were challenged to make the machine work.

133.name: Enemies of the System
133.label: Enemies of the System
133.description: When this is scored, Water cannot be played next round.
133.flavor_text: The  Ultimate Protobot and his minions wreak havoc in System Defender. Luckily, the Elite Penguin Force has strong defenses to counteract their attempts. Agents, your orders are in the Command Room.

134.name: Holiday Dojo Lights
134.label: Holiday Dojo Lights
134.description: When this is played, Fire cards become Snowball for this round.
134.flavor_text: At the Holiday Party 2010, the island was brightly lit. How many lights, you ask? Over 1000 bulbs shone bright in the  Courtyard alone. Sensei really, really likes decorating.

135.name: Wii Rollin' Riot
135.label: Wii Rollin' Riot
135.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Purple card.
135.flavor_text: In Club Penguin's  Game Day for Wii, the Rollin' Riot game's challenge is to make the biggest snowball... just make sure your opponents don't take yours!

136.name: Brown Puffle Cliff
136.label: Brown Puffle Cliff
136.description: When this is scored, Fire cannot be played next round.
136.flavor_text: We were excited to go on a Wilderness Expedition in January 2011. Once through the  Tree Maze and onto the boat, we crossed a bay and were faced with cliffs and caves. Then we discovered the inventive brown puffle!

137.name: Coins for Change Goal!
137.label: Coins for Change Goal!
137.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Fire card.
137.flavor_text: Filling the Lighthouse during  Coins for Change 2010 was an awesome challenge. We did it! And the virtual Club Penguin coins meant real donations went to help kids around the globe.

138.name: Sensei Water Battle
138.label: Sensei Water Battle
138.description: When this is scored, Fire cannot be played next round.
138.flavor_text: The last step to becoming a Water Ninja is defeating Sensei in battle. Though his skills are legendary, the way to defeating him is dedication. Keep trying, no matter what, and victory will be yours.

139.name: Green Puffles in Jet Pack Adventure
139.label: Green Puffles in Jet Pack Adventure
139.prompt: Green Puffles in Jet Pack Adventure
139.description: When this is scored, Snow cannot be played next round.
139.flavor_text: If you're looking for an edge in the game Jet Pack Adventure, take a green puffle with you. These talented fliers will go around collecting coins, and will look for extra fuel if you start to run out!

140.name: Water Dojo
140.label: Water Dojo
140.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Red card.
140.flavor_text: The Water Dojo is a place of mist and mystery. Ninjas journey here to train in the ancient art of Card-Jitsu Water. Speak with Sensei to arrange a match. Those who do must be prepared to compete... and to swim.

141.name: White Puffle
141.label: White Puffle
141.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Yellow card.
141.flavor_text: A snowflake. A single sheet of blank paper. A white puffle. Small things can sometimes conceal great power.

142.name: Yarr
142.label: Yarr
142.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Snowball card.
142.flavor_text: "Avast!" cries Rockhopper. "What be them flares on the horizon? What's that Yarr? Arr, I think it be a message from me buddies at Club Penguin too."

143.name: AQUA GRABBER
143.label: AQUA GRABBER
143.description: When this is scored, discard one Opponent's Fire card.
143.flavor_text: "I've taken the Aqua Grabber out on many deep sea salvage missions," proclaims the purple penguin. "My pink puffle helps me find the really rare treasures."

144.name: PUFFLE SCIENCE
144.label: PUFFLE SCIENCE
144.description: WHEN THIS IS SCORED, DISCARD ONE OPPONENT'S GREEN CARD.
144.flavor_text: When brown puffles were discovered in January 2011, their talents for technology were quickly discovered. In this photograph, a brown puffle is seen using an advanced quantum laser to enlarge a cookie.

145.name: PUFFLE PARTYING
145.label: PUFFLE PARTYING
145.description: WHEN THIS IS SCORED, DISCARD ONE OPPONENT'S SNOWBALL CARD.
145.flavor_text: Puffles love to celebrate! No matter what the occasion, they're always ready to party hearty. This orange puffle is showing his enthusiasm by diving in to the 2010 Fair. Take your puffle out to play by clicking on their leash.

146.flavor_text: "Talk about an incredible job," the Keeper exclaims in the middle of a bounce. "Every day dancing is required..."
146.name: Keeper of the Night Club
146.label: Keeper of the Night Club
146.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Green card.

147.name: EPF Under Attack
147.label: EPF Under Attack
147.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Water card.
147.flavor_text: In January 2011, Secret Agents were told to report to System Defender in the Command Room. Specialized skills and honed instinct help the Elite Penguin Force. Join by invitation of someone on the squad.

148.name: Elite Comm Class Agents
148.label: Elite Comm Class Agents
148.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Blue card.
148.flavor_text: Comm class agents of the Elite Penguin Force are the eyes and ears of the island's secret agency. They know information wins battles. Join the EPF today by accepting an invitation from an agent and taking the test.

149.name: EPF Agents
149.label: EPF Agents
149.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Fire card.
149.flavor_text: Classified Information: Rookie and Jet Pack Guy are rumored to be Elite Penguin Force Agents. Become a secret agent by responding to  another agent's invite and taking the test.

150.name: Elite Puffle: Flare
150.label: Elite Puffle: Flare
150.description: When this is scored, discard one opponent's Water card.
150.flavor_text: Some member penguins entered the Unlock Code from the Club Penguin DS game and got the Elite Puffle, Flare. Its welding skills and blue flames make it intense.

1.flavor_text: Sweeping the sands of liberty. Only the truest of sand castles may be thwarted by the mightiest of penguins.
1.name: Mobile Fire 1
1.label: Mobile Fire 1

2.flavor_text: A fortress mighty enough for a king. A traveling agent ready for deployment.
2.name: Mobile Snow 1
2.label: Mobile Snow 1

4.flavor_text: There is no war in Ba Sing Se.
4.name: Mobile Fire Power Card 1
4.label: Mobile Fire Power Card 1
4.description: When this is scored, your card gets +2 for the next round
